songs.title: bass 2 bass
trivia: bass 2 bass was one of the Class A unlocks in jubeat. In jubeat ripples and its APPEND version, it can be unlocked by reaching rank A2 with 28,500 AP.
In jubeat knit and its APPEND version, it is one of the Indigo Shirt unlocks.
In jubeat copious and its APPEND version, it is one of the UFO unlocks of the copious travel unlocking system.
In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it was part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 77.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
bass 2 bass marks Ryutaro Nakahara's first appearance in the jubeat series.
According to Ryu☆, bass 2 bass was created for jubeat beginner players [1].
bass 2 bass's jubeat EXTREME chart has a notecount of 573, the KONAMI number.

bass 2 bass is one of four jubeat crossovers for beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS as part of the jubeat×beatmania IIDX APPEND STYLE event. bass 2 bass is made playable by playing jubeat ripples on March 8th, 2010 onwards and having a save file on the player's e-AMUSEMENT PASS.
bass 2 bass is unlockable in REFLEC BEAT as of March 8th, 2011 by playing さよならトリップ, as part of the jubeat knit APPEND FESTIVAL event.
songs.songConnections:
bass 2 bass is the prequel to Light Shine, which appears in beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS.

Portions of bass 2 bass sound similar to My Oh My and Barbie Girl by Aqua.

bass 2 bass' rap samples originate from Witness, a vocal track found in Masterbits' Rapsody sample pack.

An extended version of bass 2 bass appears in Ryu☆'s first album, starmine.
A tech dance remix by Remo-con, titled bass 2 bass -Remo-con Tech Dance Remix-, also appears in starmine.

A speed remix of bass 2 bass by dj MAX STEROID, titled bass 2 bass (dj MAX STEROID Remix), appears in the cyber beatnation 2 -Hi Speed conclusion- CD.

Another remix of bass 2 bass by Tracy vs. Astronomical, titled bass 2 bass (Tracy vs. Astronomical Remix), appears in SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN.

songs.title: Evans
songs.bpm: 185 (all other games, DanceDanceRevolution BEGINNER), 185-369 (all DanceDanceRevolution difficulties except BEGINNER)
trivia: Evans can be unlocked in jubeat from December 15th, 2008 by clearing SigSig while online matching. In jubeat ripples and its APPEND version, it can be unlocked by reaching rank SS with 53,000 AP.
In jubeat knit and its APPEND version, it is one of the Indigo Shirt unlocks.
In jubeat copious and its APPEND version, it is one of the UFO unlocks of the copious travel unlocking system.
In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default.
Evans marks DJ YOSHITAKA's debut in the jubeat series.
Evans' EXTREME chart is the only Level 10 chart in the original jubeat to remain rated at Level 10 as of jubeat clan.
Evans is the only original composition from the original jubeat game to never be removed at any point in the series.
When all of Evans' jubeat charts are cleared with a FULL COMBO, the jubeat title part "with 朱雀" is obtained, which references Yoshitaka Nishimura's 朱雀 alias.

Evans is one of four jubeat crossovers for beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS as part of the jubeat×beatmania IIDX APPEND STYLE event. Evans is accessed on the e-AMUSEMENT network by having played bass 2 bass, IN THE NAME OF LOVE, Special One, and AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND on beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS.
songs.songConnections:
A different version of Evans, titled Evans -prototype-, is used for its BEGINNER, NORMAL, and HYPER charts in beatmania IIDX, its Battle charts in pop'n music, and its NOVICE, ADVANCED, and EXHAUST charts in SOUND VOLTEX. This version has simplified melodies and is a pre-production version of the song. It is available on the jubeat ripples APPEND SOUNDTRACK album.

A remix of Evans by cosMo＠暴走P, titled Evans VolteX Pf arrange, appears in SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH.

A rock remix of Evans by TLION69, titled Evans -TLION69 Remix-, appears in GITADORA.

A piano arrangement of Evans by まらしぃ, titled Evans ～NOSTALGIA Ver. ～, appears in ノスタルジア.

A chiptune arrangement of Evans by Sgr.Aoyama, titled Evans -Reiwa 8bit Ver.-, appears on the beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE exclusive album BEMANI 8bit collection.

songs.title: SigSig
trivia: SigSig was added to jubeat on December 15th, 2008. It can be played from jubeat to copious APPEND with an e-AMUSEMENT PASS. In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
SigSig's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
The DanceDanceRevolution series uses the jubeat jacket of SigSig, without the beatmania IIDX logo.

SigSig [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE. It could be purchased with 200 T-emo from December 3rd, 2018 to January 7th, 2019. It can be purchased again with 150 T-emo from July 1st to August 4th, 2019, from February 3rd to March 2nd, 2020, and from December 7th, 2020 to January 4th, 2021.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.

SigSig is one of the Stage 3 unlocks of pop'n music 16 PARTY♪'s Atsumare! pop'n PARTY♪ (あつまれ！ポップンパーティー♪) event. It could be unlocked from June 25th, 2008. From August 6th, 2008, it is available by default.
According to wac, SigSig was put in pop'n music 16 PARTY♪ due to its overwhelming popularity.
SigSig does not have a 2P color.
Prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, SigSig's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in the DanceDanceRevolution series.
songs.songConnections:
SigSig is part of kors k's "CANDY RAVE" song series.

An extended version of SigSig, titled SigSig (original extended), appears in the teranoid underground edition album.
A remix by RaverRose, titled SigSig (Raver Rose remix), also appears in teranoid underground edition.
An extended version of SigSig (Raver Rose mix), titled SigSig (RaverRose remix Full Size version) appears in the teranoid anthems live@underground album.

A remix of SigSig by DJ TECHNORCH, titled SigSig -Dark Side Remix-, appears in the cyber beatnation 1st conclusion album.

An updated version of SigSig with altered elements was played by kors k during the beatnation summit Premium Live encore. A studio version of this version can be found in kors k's Ways For Liberation album.

Another remix of SigSig, titled SigSig (DJ Depath & M-Project Remix), appears in the Land of Passion album.

22 seconds are edited out of the REFLEC BEAT and BeatStream versions of SigSig, mostly the intro.
Unlike the other BEMANI crossovers from the original REFLEC BEAT that were edited in length and were not removed in REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!, SigSig's original song length was never restored.

A speed remix of SigSig by Ryu☆, SigSig (Ryu☆ Remix), appears in the cyber beatnation 2 -Hi Speed conclusion- CD.

In the UchusentaiNOIZ song FLASHBACK FLAG the keyboard plays a bit of the main melody of SigSig.

A part of SigSig's main melody is recreated on On My Wings(SAISEN TURN Special Remix) by SAISEN TURN using the Martin Garrix Animals pluck sound.

A piano remix of SigSig by maras k appears in their third album, Beat Piano Music 3.

A self-remix of SigSig, titled SigSig 2023, appears in kors k's Candy Rave Land Vol.1 album, alongside an extended version of it.
Another remix by KOTONOHOUSE, titled SigSig (KOTONOHOUSE Remix), also appears in Candy Rave Land Vol.1.

songs.title: 凛として咲く花の如く
songs.titleNorm: 凛として咲く花の如く
trivia: 凛として咲く花の如く was added to jubeat on December 15th, 2008. It can be played from jubeat to copious APPEND with an e-AMUSEMENT PASS. In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it was part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 28.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default.
凛として咲く花の如く's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

On most of the advertisement for jubeat plus' CHALLENGE SCRATCH that features this song, 凛として咲く花の如く shows a slightly different variation of its jubeat jacket, which omits the pop'n music logo and has its title and artist romanized.

凛として咲く花の如く is the first non-crossover event BEMANI song to appear in all BEMANI games that were current at the time of its release, either remixed or not. 凛として咲く花の如く was also planned to be in the cancelled BEMANI title, おといろは.
凛として咲く花の如く's pop'n music charts were created by TOMOSUKE himself [2].

凛として咲く花の如く was a hidden song in beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS. It can be unlocked upon unlocking every hidden song in the game. Unlike the other new hidden unlock in EMPRESS, Jack, it received a unique video.
As of January 7th, 2009 (beat #1), it was automatically unlocked for everyone to play.
In the arcade version of beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS, 凛として咲く花の如く's title was written as 凛として咲く花のごとく. This was fixed in beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS and beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS + PREMIUM BEST.
In うたっち, 凛として咲く花の如く can be bought in the Shop for 4500 points.
songs.songConnections:
A long version of 凛として咲く花の如く appears in the pop'n music 15 ADVENTURE AC ♥ CS pop'n music 14 FEVER! original soundtrack and on the KONAMI♪MUSICフル ALBUM.
The GuitarFreaks & DrumMania series uses a game size of this version of 凛として咲く花の如く.
The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shortened version of the GuitarFreaks & DrumMania cut.

The beatmania IIDX version of 凛として咲く花の如く is a combination of both the pop'n music and GuitarFreaks & DrumMania versions.

The REFLEC BEAT series' old charts uses a shorter version of the pop'n music version of 凛として咲く花の如く, mostly cutting out the intro and the break.

A lounge arrangement of 凛として咲く花の如く by hacomaco appears in the pop'n music Cafe music selection album.

A remix of 凛として咲く花の如く by マチゲリータ, titled 凛として咲く花の如く スプーキィテルミィンミックス, appears in SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH.

An instrumental version of 凛として咲く花の如く can be found in the SOUND VOLTEX FLOOR website as an "audition" song for the VOCAL category in the SDVX × DTM MAGAZINE Collaboration Contest (SDVX × DTM MAGAZINE コラボレーションコンテスト), and the Continuing the Seniors! The Second Vocalist Contest (先輩に続け！第2回ボーカリストコンテスト).

A cover version of 凛として咲く花の如く by tricot appears in their 凛として咲く花の如く single.
A short version of tricot's version was used for the announcement video of ひなビタ♪ [1].

Another cover version of 凛として咲く花の如く by the ひなビタ♪ cast, titled 凛として咲く花の如く～ひなビタ♪edition～, appears in REFLEC BEAT colette -Summer-.

凛として咲く花の如く appears as part of the PM SUPER BEST すぺしゃるメドレー, a medley by Tsugumi Kataoka that appears in the pop'n music SUPER BEST BOX compilation album.

A toybox-like arrangement of 凛として咲く花の如く is used on the final cutscene of the HinaBitter♪ OverDrive! (ひなビタ♪OverDrive!) event of GITADORA OverDrive.

凛として咲く花の如く is related to 黒髪乱れし修羅となりて, NADESHIKO METAL from pop'n music 18 せんごく列伝.

The ノスタルジア series uses a piano arrangement of 凛として咲く花の如く.

Another remix of 凛として咲く花の如く by The 4th, titled 凛として咲く花の如く (The 4th Remix), appears in The 4th's Force of The 4th album.

A symphonic arrangement of 凛として咲く花の如く by 大嶋 啓之, titled 凛として咲く花の如く (Orchestra Arr.), appears in the BEMANI SYMPHONY ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album.

Another cover of 凛として咲く花の如く by 大神ミオ, titled 凛として咲く花の如く (大神ミオ Cover), appears in jubeat Ave. and SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR.

凛として咲く花の如く was featured in the ～pop'n music MEGAMIX～, performed at the EDP × beatnation summit 2025 event.

songs.title: TRUE♥LOVE
trivia: TRUE♥LOVE was added to jubeat on December 15th, 2008. It can be played from jubeat to copious APPEND with an e-AMUSEMENT PASS. In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
TRUE♥LOVE is the first BEMANI crossover in jubeat to originate from the DanceDanceRevolution series.
TRUE♥LOVE was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.
TRUE♥LOVE's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

On the American and European versions of DanceDanceRevolution before DanceDanceRevolution A, TRUE♥LOVE's artist was credited to jun. Curiously, TRUE♥LOVE's DanceDanceRevolution jacket is based on its American/European banner, rather than its original banner.
TRUE♥LOVE appears as downloadable content for DanceDanceRevolution (PS3), in the DDR SuperNOVA Greatest Hits 1 pack.
In DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, TRUE♥LOVE received its difficulty change from DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 3rd, 2024.

TRUE♥LOVE received CHALLENGE charts in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode on May 15th, 2025, which become available by purchasing GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.1 (グランプリ譜面パック vol.1). By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, TRUE♥LOVE's CHALLENGE charts can be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD.
From May 29th, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players.
songs.songConnections:
A slower dance remix of TRUE♥LOVE by Clubstar, titled TRUE♥LOVE (Clubstar's True Club Mix), appears in the DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA Limited Edition Music Sampler CD.
A short version of TRUE♥LOVE (Clubstar's True Club Mix) appears in the Japanese version of DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY.

Slang was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.
Slang's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

songs.title: Insanity: Luna
trivia: Insanity: Luna is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from July 24th to August 22nd, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from July 24th to August 20th, 2024. Since February 1st, 2025, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.

songs.title: Cranberry
trivia: Cranberry is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It can be unlocked from release date after having unlocked Victory of the Century.
Cranberry marks Yoshihiko Koeuka's first song in his fruit series to debut in jubeat since Cassis in jubeat saucer. It's also his first song in jubeat since Cassis to credit him under his real name.
Cranberry was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.
Cranberry is available in コナステ GITADORA by purchasing Konasute GITADORA BEMANI SELECTION PACK vol.2 (コナステ GITADORA BEMANIセレクションパック vol.2).

Cranberry is one of the unlockable songs in GITADORA GALAXY WAVE DELTA's Daihousou awasero channel! GALAXY MUSIC PARADE! (大放送あわせろチャンネル！GALAXY MUSIC PARADE！) event. It can be unlocked from July 9th, 2025.
songs.songConnections: Cranberry is part of Yoshihiko Koezuka's song series named after a fruit.

songs.title: Insanity: Sol
trivia: Insanity: Sol is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from July 24th to August 22nd, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from July 24th to August 20th, 2024. Since February 1st, 2025, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.

songs.title: 怪獣大戦争
trivia: 怪獣大戦争 is the GENT unlock of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from December 14th, 2022 to January 3rd, 2023, and from April 19th to May 9th, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from February 7th to 27th, 2024. Since June 1st, 2024, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
怪獣大戦争 marks Asaki's first use of his Chintaro Momoyama alias in BEMANI. It is also his first original song composed for the jubeat series since イ号零型, back in jubeat saucer.

songs.title: Elysion ex machina
trivia: Elysion ex machina is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It can be unlocked from release date after having unlocked Reincarnation Of Dead Petal.
Elysion ex machina was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.

Elysion ex machina is one of the unlocks of GITADORA GALAXY WAVE's GALAXY WAVE Quest event. It could be unlocked from May 22nd to June 16th, 2024. In GITADORA GALAXY WAVE DELTA, it can be unlocked in the Daihousou awasero channel! GALAXY MUSIC PARADE! (大放送あわせろチャンネル！GALAXY MUSIC PARADE！) event from July 9th, 2025.
Elysion ex machina is available in コナステ GITADORA by purchasing Konasute GITADORA BEMANI SELECTION PACK vol.2 (コナステ GITADORA BEMANIセレクションパック vol.2).

songs.title: Explore Every Ave.
trivia: Explore Every Ave. is the main theme of jubeat Ave..

Explore Every Ave.'s EXTREME chart was written by the winner of a chart writing contest that began on June 27th, 2022 and ended on July 12th, 2022 [1]. Charts submitted for the contest could be played for a limited time on jubeat (2021) during the dates mentioned above.
Explore Every Ave. is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It will automatically be unlocked after your first play of the game.
Explore Every Ave. was added on jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.
On July, 22nd, 2022, the winner was announced: Yoshino (よしの), with their chart titled Dare mo ga sekai no tankyuusha (誰もが世界の探究者, or Everyone is a world explorer).
After the winner was announced, former in-house BEMANI artist TAG revealed that he had entered the contest under the alias Juuryoku (重力, gravity) [2].

songs.title: Lost Dream
trivia: Lost Dream is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It can be unlocked from release date after having unlocked all previous LIGHT CHAT songs.
Lost Dream marks Tatsunoshin Fujiyoshi's debut in the jubeat series. His debut was teased by the jubeat staff twitter account, as the artist under letter "T".
Lost Dream was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.

Lost Dream's BASIC chart has the fifth highest number of notes of a BASIC chart with 654 notes, beaten by Megalara Garuda's 932, Thanatøs's 856, Diastrophism's 797, and Crackpot Evangelist's 771 notes.
songs.songConnections: An extended version of Lost Dream appears in Tatsunoshin's album of the same name.

songs.title: 見えない星の渡り方
trivia: 見えない星の渡り方 is the TWINY unlock of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from September 14th to October 4th, 2022, and from January 11th to 31st, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from November 29th to December 19th, 2023. Since May 1st, 2024, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
見えない星の渡り方 marks Capchii's first original song in the jubeat series. His debut as a composer in the jubeat series was teased by the jubeat staff twitter account, as the artist under letter "C".
見えない星の渡り方 was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.
It's also his first BEMANI song without Crawk.

songs.title: Anubis
trivia: Anubis is the BOB unlock of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from October 5th to 25th, 2022, and from February 1st to 21st, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from January 17th to February 7th, 2024. Since June 1st, 2024, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
Anubis marks ARForest's debut in the jubeat series. Their debut in the jubeat series was teased by the jubeat staff twitter account, as the artist under letter "A".
Anubis was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.
It is also his first instrumental and first solo song in BEMANI.

songs.title: 和beat
trivia: 和beat is the POMPA unlock of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from August 24th to September 13th, 2022, from December 26th, 2022 to January 17th, 2023, and from May 17th to June 6th, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it can be unlocked from May 1st, 2024 by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
和beat is Shingo Kume's first KONAMI original song in BEMANI. His debut in the arcade jubeat titles was teased by the jubeat staff twitter account, as the artist under letter "F".
和beat was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.

songs.title: Flying soda
trivia: In jubeat Ave., Flying soda's title was capitalized as Flying Soda. This was fixed on September 13th, 2022.
Flying Soda is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It can be unlocked from release date after having unlocked Explore Every Ave..
Flying Soda was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.

Flying soda is one of the unlockable songs of REFLEC BEAT colette -Summer-'s Pastel Adventure colette Fishing unlocking system. From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, Flying soda was playable by default.
Flying soda marks vocalist Momoko Hayashi's debut in the REFLEC BEAT series.
In REFLEC BEAT +, Flying soda's artist was romanized as nekomata_master feat.Momoko Hayashi.
After being removed from the initial release of REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア, Flying soda was revived on April 4th, 2019.

Flying soda is one of the RISING DAY unlocks of the SPARK FESTIVAL 2019 event. It could be unlocked from August 7th to September 22nd, 2019 with 40 ★ after finishing 猫叉Master feat.林ももこ's set. It could be unlocked again from September 25th to October 6th, 2019.
It could be unlocked again from February 3rd to March 1st, 2020.
From July 29th, 2020 onwards, it can be purchased with 80 ★.
As of October 4th, 2023, it is playable by default.
songs.songConnections: A long version of Flying soda appears on 猫叉Master's fourth album, follow slowly.

songs.title: brown hawk owl
trivia: brown hawk owl is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It can be unlocked from release date after having unlocked Liar×Girl.
brown hawk owl was added to jubeat (2021) on May 24th, 2023.
songs.songConnections: brown hawk owl is part of S-C-U's "Animal" song series.

songs.title: Slipstream
trivia: Slipstream was added to jubeat (2021) on February 9th, 2022. It was later added to plus mode on June 22nd, 2022 as part of the beatmania IIDX pack 6.

Slipstream is one of the FROM IIDX-01 unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from October 19th to November 8th, 2022, and from February 22nd to March 14th, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from October 18th to November 7th, 2023. Since October 1st, 2025, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.

Slipstream is the Bayside -EMERALD- Section 2 EXTRA STAGE of the IIDX AIR RACE EXTRA STAGE system. It can be played from July 5th, 2018. From August 9th, 2018, its charts can be unlocked by clearing them once using the HARD or EX-HARD gauge.
From February 7th, 2019, its charts can be purchased in beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage via Tenshi no madousho (天使の魔導書).
From beatmania IIDX 27 HEROIC VERSE onwards, it is available by default.
Future core is a musical genre that mixes elements of future bass and hardcore. The sub-genre has been popularized in Japan's club scene by artists like YUC'e, PSYQUI, and lapix himself.

A slipstream is a region behind a moving object in which a wake of fluid (typically air or water) is moving at velocities comparable to the moving object, relative to the ambient fluid through which the object is moving.
Slipstream is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.15 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.15).
songs.songConnections: An extended version of Slipstream appears in the beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album.

songs.title: DIAMOND CROSSING
trivia: DIAMOND CROSSING is the second collaboration between Shigeharu Saeki and Toshiyuki Kakuta in BEMANI, after Confiserie from beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro and jubeat saucer. Unlike Confiserie, DIAMOND CROSSING is credited to S-C-U vs L.E.D., as opposed to L.E.D. vs S-C-U.
DIAMOND CROSSING was added to jubeat (2021) on February 9th, 2022. It was later added to plus mode on June 22nd, 2022 as part of the beatmania IIDX pack 6.
It received a new jacket in jubeat (2021).

DIAMOND CROSSING is one of the FROM IIDX-02 unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from November 16th to December 13th, 2022, and from March 29th to April 18th, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from November 8th to 28th, 2023. Since November 1st, 2025, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
DIAMOND CROSSING is Shigeharu Saeki's first beatmania IIDX original song on a default beatmania IIDX song list.
DIAMOND CROSSING's ANOTHER charts were unlocked on December 10th, 2015.
DIAMOND CROSSING received a jacket on the BEMANI Fan Site CHECK!SONGS page for November 2015. This jacket has not yet been used in a BEMANI game.
On the iTunes release of the beatmania IIDX 23 copula ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album, DIAMOND CROSSING's title was capitalized as Diamond Crossing.
"DIAMOND CROSSING" is a reference to the diamond-shaped center of the railway junction.
DIAMOND CROSSING is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.10 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.10).
songs.songConnections:
DIAMOND CROSSING is based on beatmania IIDX 23 copula's system background music.

A remix of DIAMOND CROSSING by t+pazolite, titled DIAMOND CROSSING (tpz ANTI-Overcute Remix), appears in the beatmania IIDX 23 copula ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK VOL.2 album.

songs.title: HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY
songs.artist: DJ ミラクル☆ストーン
trivia: HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY was added to jubeat (2021) on June 24th, 2022.

HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY is one of the FROM DDR-01 unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from June 7th to 27th, 2023. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from March 6th to 26th, 2024. Since January 1st, 2026, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.

HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY is one of the EXTRA STAGE songs of the Replicant D-ignition event of DanceDanceRevolution (2014). It could be played after filling the white NITRO vial. From August 6th to December 23rd, 2015, HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY could be unlocked via the EXTRA ATTACK unlocking system after filling the white NITRO vial. Note that the SURVIVED BONUS meter had to be filled on BEGINNER, then BASIC, DIFFICULT, and then finally EXPERT.
From December 24th, 2015 onwards, HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY has been automatically unlocked for all players.
HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY marks Yoshihiro Tagawa's first use of his DJ ミラクル☆ストーン alias. It is also his first original song made for the DanceDanceRevolution series.
HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY was performed live at the EXIT TUNES DANCE PARTY beatnation summit 2015 event.
HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY uses the BOOM WHITE background dance stage, a variant of the BOOM DARK stage that is recolored white to match its NITRO vial color.

HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from May 8th, 2024, by purchasing GRAND PRIX music pack vol.26 (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.26). It received brand-new CHALLENGE charts, which become available by purchasing both this and GRAND PRIX music pack vol.25 (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.25).
By purchasing both packs with an active subscription, HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY's CHALLENGE charts could be played in DanceDanceRevolution A3 and DanceDanceRevolution WORLD.
From May 30th, 2025 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, these charts are available by default for all players.
In DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY received its difficulty changes from DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 3rd, 2024.
HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.25 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.25).
songs.songConnections:
HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY is related to HAPPY☆PARADISE☆GALAXY, from REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア.

The beatmania IIDX series uses an extended version of HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY, which also replaces the "DDR" vocal sample for a "IIDX" sample.

songs.title: Love 2 Shuffle
songs.artist: BEMANI Sound Team "Sota F." feat. Starbitz
trivia: Love 2 Shuffle could be unlocked in jubeat Ave. from November 1st, 2022 to January 11th, 2023, as part of the Ichika no gochamaze Mix UP! (いちかのごちゃまぜMix UP！) event. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it can be unlocked from February 1st, 2024 by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
Love 2 Shuffle being crossed over marks Starbitz's first appearance in the jubeat and pop'n music series.

Love 2 Shuffle is one of the qualifying round songs in The 8th KONAMI Arcade Championship for DANCERUSH STARDOM. It could be unlocked from November 29th, 2018 to January 7th, 2019, by having entered The 8th KONAMI Arcade Championship. It was added to the EXTRA STAGE folder on January 29th, 2019.
From March 24th, 2021, it can be purchased with 100 ★ instead and without any prerequisites.
As of June 28th, 2023, it is available by default.

Love 2 Shuffle is part of the Maishuu! Ichika no chou BEMANI rush 2020 (毎週！いちかの超BEMANIラッシュ2020) event. It could be unlocked in pop'n music peace from September 23rd, 2020 until October 29th, 2020. From pop'n music UniLab onwards, it is available by default.
In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, Love 2 Shuffle displays its jacket on the song selection screen.
Love 2 Shuffle is available in pop'n music Lively by purchasing pop'n music peace Music Pack vol.17 (ポップンミュージック peace 楽曲パック vol.17).
songs.songConnections: A remixed mashup of Necroxis Girl and Love 2 Shuffle by SYUNN, titled Dance With The Dead, can be found in DANCERUSH STARDOM and jubeat Ave..

songs.title: Dance With The Dead
trivia: Dance With The Dead is a song part of the Ichika no gochamaze Mix UP! (いちかのごちゃまぜMix UP！) event. It could be unlocked in DANCERUSH STARDOM and jubeat Ave. from November 1st, 2022 to January 11th, 2023. In DANCERUSH STARDOM, it could be unlocked with ★s from December 27th, 2023. From November 26th, 2025, it is available by default.
In jubeat beyond the Ave., it can be unlocked from December 1st, 2023 by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
Smith and MOTTIE appear in Dance With The Dead's jacket.

Dance With The Dead is one of DanceDanceRevolution A3's EXTRA SAVIOR A3 songs. It can be unlocked from April 4th, 2024 for 20th anniversary model cabinets, and from April 8th, 2024 for regular cabinets. As of DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, it is available by default.

Dance With The Dead is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX as an EXTRA STAGE song from April 8th, 2024. It is available in GRAND PRIX mode from March 31st, 2025, by purchasing GRAND PRIX music pack vol.35 (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.35).
songs.songConnections: Dance With The Dead is a remixed mashup of Love 2 Shuffle, from DANCERUSH STARDOM, and Necroxis Girl, from jubeat clan.

songs.title: Insanity
trivia: Insanity is one of the unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It could be unlocked from July 24th to August 22nd, 2023 after having obtained a FULL COMBO on both Insanity: Luna and Insanity: Sol on any difficulty. In jubeat beyond the Ave., it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from July 24th to August 20th, 2024. Since February 1st, 2025, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE, after having previously unlocked After Rain, Anubis, Insanity: Luna, Insanity: Sol, manticore, Reach The Sky, 怪獣大戦争, 見えない星の渡り方, and 和beat.

songs.title: 隅田川夏恋歌
trivia: 隅田川夏恋歌 is obtained in jubeat ripples and its APPEND version upon reaching the rank of Gold Tiger. In jubeat knit and its APPEND version, it is one of the Indigo Shirt unlocks.
In jubeat copious and its APPEND version, it is one of the UFO unlocks of the copious travel unlocking system.
In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it is part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 33.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
隅田川夏恋歌 marks Kiyoshi Murai's debut in the jubeat series.

According to Kiyoshi Murai on an interview on the WE LOVE pop'n music Minna de tsukutte 20 website, 隅田川夏恋歌 was sped-up 1.5 times from its original speed after discussion with the jubeat staff, who deemed that the "tempo was too slow".
隅田川夏恋歌 is one of the only two KONAMI originals from jubeat ripples never removed at any point in the jubeat arcade series, the other being Russian Snowy Dance.
隅田川夏恋歌 was the only song to receive a difficulty change between jubeat ripples and jubeat knit.
隅田川夏恋歌 is the first BEMANI crossover to come from jubeat ripples.

隅田川夏恋歌 received a new, unique video in BeatStream. Alt, with the same appearance as her sprite for this song in pop'n music, makes a cameo over two-thirds in. In the same scene, different animations of the FIREWORK marker from jubeat can be seen up in the sky.
songs.songConnections:
A long version of 隅田川夏恋歌 appears in the jubeat ripples APPEND SOUNDTRACK and 0/1 ANGEL albums.

A rock arrangement of 隅田川夏恋歌, titled 隅田川夏恋歌～納涼mix, appears in GuitarFreaksXG3 & DrumManiaXG3.

A remix of 隅田川夏恋歌 by Daisuke Ohnuma(大福P), titled 隅田川夏恋歌 (I/O Angel mix), appears in SOUND VOLTEX II -infinite infection-.

An instrumental version of 隅田川夏恋歌 can be found in the SOUND VOLTEX FLOOR website as an "audition" song for the Continuing the Seniors! The Second Vocalist Contest (先輩に続け！第2回ボーカリストコンテスト).

A piano arrangement of 隅田川夏恋歌 by red glasses, without ALT, appears in ノスタルジア.
Another piano arrangement by 事務員G appears in the BEMANI PIANO COLLECTION ノスタルジア album.

A remixed cover of 隅田川夏恋歌 by PRIDASK, titled 隅田川夏恋歌 (STARDOM Remix), appears in DANCERUSH STARDOM.

Another cover of 隅田川夏恋歌, titled 隅田川夏恋歌 (珠村日乃和 Cover), appears in ポラリスコード.

songs.title: AREA 51
trivia: AREA 51 is obtained in jubeat ripples and its APPEND version upon reaching the rank of Silver Lion. In jubeat knit and its APPEND version, it is one of the Indigo Shirt unlocks.
In jubeat copious and its APPEND version, it is one of the UFO unlocks of the copious travel unlocking system.
In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.

AREA 51 is available in GuitarFreaksXG2 & DrumManiaXG2 as part of the jubeat knit APPEND FESTIVAL from March 9th, 2011. Playing the song on GuitarFreaksXG2 & DrumManiaXG2 will unlock Jailbreak for play in jubeat knit APPEND.
AREA 51 was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.
AREA 51's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
AREA 51's title refers to the United States Air Force military base located in Nevada, made known in 1947 by the public's beliefs that UFOs were spotted around the base and being kept there.
AREA 51 is available in コナステ GITADORA by purchasing Konasute GITADORA HISTORY PACK vol.12 (コナステ GITADORA HISTORYパック vol.12).
songs.songConnections:
A long version of AREA 51, titled AREA 51 (Re-Rec LONG version), appears in the jubeat ripples APPEND SOUNDTRACK and 96's BLACK ALBUM CDs.

AREA 51 shares part of its melody with SPACE DRIVER, from GITADORA.

trivia: STARLIT DUST/スティルに捧ぐ is obtained in jubeat ripples and its APPEND version upon reaching the rank of Gold Fox. In jubeat knit and its APPEND version, it is one of the Indigo Shirt unlocks.

STARLIT DUST/スティルに捧ぐ marks Osamu Migitera's first contribution to the jubeat series.

STARLIT DUST/スティルに捧ぐ's title translates to "STARLIT DUST/Dedicated to Still". The subtitle is a reference to Jason Michael "Stillwind" Borenstein, who passed away on February 7th, 2009 due to a ruptured aorta. The song's English subtitle in jukebeat, For The Late Stillwind, confirms this. STARLIT DUST/スティルに捧ぐ also appears as February 7th's "Today's recommended song" (きょうのオススメ楽曲) in the jubeat series.
STARLIT DUST/スティルに捧ぐ was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.

Queen's Paradise is Nanako's first credited appearance in a KONAMI original song. Extended comments were posted in her blog. She might have sung one of the licensed covers in jubeat before this (she also indirectly mentioned it in an older blog post), but she did not mention which song it was.

Queen's Paradise [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE. It could be purchased with 100 T-emo from March 4th to April 1st, 2019. It could be purchased again with 50 T-emo from September 2nd to October 7th, 2019, from April 6th to May 7th, 2020, and from June 1st to July 6th, 2020.
songs.songConnections: A long version of Queen's Paradise appears on the jubeat ripples APPEND SOUNDTRACK album.

trivia: coming true is obtained in jubeat ripples and its APPEND version upon reaching the rank of Gold Ocelot. In jubeat knit and its APPEND version, it is one of the Indigo Shirt unlocks.

coming true marks the debut of Toshiyuki Kakuta and M-Project in the jubeat series.

When all of coming true's charts are cleared with and without a FULL COMBO, the jubeat title parts "THE COMPLETE OF L Vs. G" and "THE CONQUEST OF L Vs. G" are obtained, respectively. These title parts reference an earlier GUHROOVY and L.E.D. song, COMPLETE CONQUEST.

A remix of coming true by Darwin, titled coming true (Darwin Remix), appears on GUHROOVY's second album, HARDCORE LIFE+.

songs.title: AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND
trivia: AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND is part of the jubeat×beatmania IIDX APPEND STYLE event. It can be accessed on the e-AMUSEMENT network by having played bass 2 bass, IN THE NAME OF LOVE, and Special One on beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS, which unlocks the song for play in jubeat ripples APPEND. The song must then be played on jubeat ripples APPEND, which will unlock the song for play in beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS on subsequent plays. From jubeat knit to copious APPEND, it can be played with an e-AMUSEMENT PASS.
In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.

AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND's EXTREME chart is the first chart in jubeat to break 900 notes, with 967. It originally had the highest number of notes of any song in an arcade release of jubeat until jubeat saucer, where it was first beaten by アストライアの双皿's 988 notes. The EXTREME chart had the highest number of notes of any song in the series until ねこバス ～となりのトトロ～ from the jubeat plus ハイテンションジブリ pack 2, with 1000.
AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND received a BEGINNER chart in beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle.

AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND was added to beatmania IIDX INFINITAS as part of the January 2016 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. On May 18th, 2016, it became unlockable through the Akashic Explore event for players who did not already have it.
songs.songConnections: A long version of AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND appears on GUHROOVY's HARDCORE LIFE album.

少年リップルズ marks both Yu Tokiwa's and Jun Wakita's first appearances in the jubeat series. It also marks the first time Yu Tokiwa sings in Japanese in BEMANI outside her risette songs.

According to wac, 少年リップルズ was composed while bug testing pop'n music 18 せんごく列伝 (which took longer than expected for him) by request of jubeat sound director Mutsuhiko Izumi, who wanted him to do a J-POP song. Because of Tokiwa's limited availability, wac himself had to write the lyrics to 少年リップルズ the day before recording of the song began, which was on/around Christmas Eve 2009.
少年リップルズ was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.

少年リップルズ is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) from February 9th, 2022 by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS jubeat Selection Music Pack vol.1 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS jubeat セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1).
少年リップルズ's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

少年リップルズ and its UPPER charts are available in pop'n music Lively as part of the jubeat Selection Music Pack vol.1 (ユビートセレクション 楽曲パック vol.1).

trivia: FLOWER could be unlocked in jubeat knit APPEND as part of the APPEND FESTIVAL event, by playing さよならトリップ in REFLEC BEAT. By then playing FLOWER in jubeat knit APPEND, the song was available in REFLEC BEAT. In jubeat copious and its APPEND version, it is one of the UFO unlocks of the copious travel unlocking system. In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it is part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 43.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default.

FLOWER has slight variations in its jacket depending on which game it appears in. Its jubeat jacket features a blue flower and the rear end of a piglet. The character in FLOWER's jubeat jacket is named Charlie. This jacket is also used in DANCE aROUND, DanceDanceRevolution, SOUND VOLTEX, and ポップンリズミン.

Its REFLEC BEAT jacket features a red flower and the front end of the same piglet. The character in FLOWER's REFLEC BEAT jacket is named Cathleen. This jacket is also used in ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom Ver.2. FLOWER's jubeat and REFLEC BEAT jackets are used as the pop'n music background.
Its MÚSECA jacket features the red flower from the REFLEC BEAT jacket, the rear-facing pig from the jubeat jacket, and MÚSECA sound director Dory's mask in place of Charlie.

FLOWER is the first song to appear in some form in every active BEMANI series at the time of its debut, and has appeared in every BEMANI series that has been active at any time since it debuted. In all, it has appeared in beatmania IIDX, BeatStream, CHUNITHM, DANCE aROUND, DanceDanceRevolution, DanceEvolution, DANCERUSH, GROOVE COASTER, GuitarFreaks & DrumMania, jubeat, maimai, MÚSECA, pop'n music, REFLEC BEAT, SOUND VOLTEX, Synchronica, ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom, ノスタルジア, and 太鼓の達人 (a total of 19 games). As a result, some players consider this an inside joke.

FLOWER's video in beatmania IIDX shows a live performance of DJ YOSHITAKA playing FLOWER at the Rainbow☆Rainbow Release Party held on January 29th, 2012. The intro of the video shows the jubeat version of the FLOWER jacket, while at the end the REFLEC BEAT version is shown.
FLOWER's jubeat and REFLEC BEAT jackets appear in a question in the BEMANI Exam on KONAMI's arcade game QUIZ MAGIC ACADEMY Kenja no tobira (クイズマジックアカデミー 賢者の扉).

FLOWER was crossed over to GROOVE COASTER EX, maimai ORANGE and 太鼓の達人 キミドリVer. on October 29th, 2014 as part of the Tenkaichi otogesai Zenkoku issei nintei taikai (天下一音ゲ祭 全国一斉認定大会) event. In the other music games, FLOWER uses a slightly modified version of its jubeat jacket, adding the jubeat saucer fulfill logo.
Also in the other music games (and the SOUND VOLTEX series as well), the artist was slightly changed to DJ YOSHITAKA「jubeat」より.

songs.title: 量子の海のリントヴルム
songs.titleNorm: 量子の海のリントヴルム
trivia: 量子の海のリントヴルム is one of the hidden songs in jubeat copious. It could be unlocked by getting a FULL COMBO on a Level 10 song with 3 other people at the same time either offline or online. In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.

量子の海のリントヴルム could be unlocked in REFLEC BEAT limelight by reaching the first part of jubeat Glass Stage 3. In REFLEC BEAT colette, it could be unlocked by reaching Stage 3 of Pastel Adventure in the jubeat mountain unlock system.
After the removal of the jubeat plus copious pack 06, 量子の海のリントヴルム was not available again until the release of jubeat (2021).
量子の海のリントヴルム's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

量子の海のリントヴルム is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from June 24th, 2022, by purchasing SPECIAL music pack feat.jubeat vol.2 (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.jubeat vol.2). Its CHALLENGE charts become available by purchasing both this and SPECIAL music pack feat.jubeat vol.1 (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.jubeat vol.1).
量子の海のリントヴルム is one of the unlocks of ポラリスコード's Hakkutsu! Caravan universe (発掘！キャラバンユニバース) event, through the jubeat chousa location (jubeat調査ロケ) route. It can be unlocked from June 4th, 2025.

"Ryoushi no umi no Lindwurm" (量子の海のリントヴルム) translates to "quantum sea Lindwurm". A Lindwurm (or lindworm) is, according to Brit heraldry, a term for a wingless bipedal dragon, often with a venomous bite. In Norway heraldry, though, it can also refer to sea serpents.
From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, 量子の海のリントヴルム was available by default.
songs.songConnections:
The beatmania IIDX and pop'n music version of 量子の海のリントヴルム is mixed slightly differently from the version used in other BEMANI games.

量子の海のリントヴルム is related to the other Kuroneko Dungeon songs, 龍と少女とデコヒーレンス and リリーゼと炎龍レーヴァテイン.
Both 量子の海のリントヴルム and 龍と少女とデコヒーレンス make references to quantum physics in their titles.

A rock arrangement of 量子の海のリントヴルム by 96, titled 量子の海のリントヴルム（GITADOROCK Ver.）, appears in GITADORA.

量子の海のリントヴルム appears as part of POLICY BREAK Medley from SOUND VOLTEX×jubeat, which appears in SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN.

A symphonic arrangement of 量子の海のリントヴルム by Osamu Kubota, titled 量子の海のリントヴルム (Orchestra Arr.), appears in the BEMANI SYMPHONY ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album.
A short version of 量子の海のリントヴルム (Orchestra Arr.), titled 量子の海のリントヴルム (BEMANI SYMPHONY NOSTALGIA mix), appears in ノスタルジア Op.3.

A remix of 量子の海のリントヴルム by かめりあ, titled 量子の海のリントヴルム (STARDOM Remix), appears in DANCERUSH STARDOM.

800nm is the fifth unlockable song in the ギタ・ドラ・jubeat 大夏祭り event. To unlock it, you must first unlock the store for RePrise. After that, you must unlock the store for 800nm. Once the store is open, the following songs must be played on their respective machines: bass 2 bass - jubeat
I'm so Happy - jubeat
532nm - jubeat
In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Emerald STAGE 9 unlocks of jubeat Qubell's dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
800nm was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.
800nm's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
songs.songConnections:
800nm is part of Ryu☆'s song series named after wavelengths of light.

An extended version of 800nm, titled 800nm (Extended Mix), appears in Ryu☆'s fourth album, Sakura Luminance.
Another extended version, titled 800nm (SUNLiGHT Mix), appears in Ryu☆'s third best of album, Ryu☆BEST -SUNLiGHT-.

songs.title: ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ
songs.titleNorm: ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ
trivia: ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ is the main theme of the ギタ・ドラ・jubeat 大夏祭り event. It was used in the KONAMI video promoting the aforementioned event. Also, KONAMI uploaded a video featuring a dance routine of ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ, performed by Yoshihiko Koezuka and Shigeharu Saeki themselves.

ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ is the ninth unlockable song in the ギタ・ドラ・jubeat 大夏祭り event. To unlock it, you must unlock and play Riot of Color in jubeat copious APPEND and GuitarFreaksXG3 & DrumManiaXG3. In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ's jubeat charts were created by まっする.
In jukebeat, ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ's title was changed to GITA DORA jubeat DAINATSUMATSURI! and the artist is credited as DNM MORIAGETAI.
ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.
ギタ・ドラ・jubeat大夏祭りのテーマ is available in コナステ GITADORA by purchasing Konasute GITADORA HISTORY PACK vol.13 (コナステ GITADORA HISTORYパック vol.13).
The "DNM" in DNM盛り上げ隊 may stand for "Dainatsumatsuri".

songs.title: quaver♪
songs.bpm: 186 (REFLEC BEAT), 182-186 (beatmania IIDX, BeatStream, DanceDanceRevolution, jubeat, pop'n music, SOUND VOLTEX)
trivia: quaver♪ marks the first time when dj TAKA uses his Risk Junk alias in the REFLEC BEAT and jubeat series. The appearance of quaver♪ in REFLEC BEAT limelight also breaks the chain of Risk Junk songs originating only in even-numbered beatmania IIDX games.

quaver♪'s BPM increases from 182 at the start, to 184 in the middle, then to 186 near the end. While the beatmania IIDX, BeatStream, DanceDanceRevolution, jubeat, pop'n music, and SOUND VOLTEX series show the correct BPM (182-186), the REFLEC BEAT series shows quaver♪'s BPM as just 186.

quaver♪ is one of the bistro saucer 1st Set unlocks of jubeat saucer. It could be unlocked from September 25th to October 31st, 2012. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
From jubeat beyond the Ave. onwards, it is available by default with an e-amusement pass.
quaver♪'s jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat clan ratings on March 7th, 2022.

quaver♪ can be unlocked in REFLEC BEAT limelight by reaching Glass Stage 10. It is the final song of the limelight Glass Stages. In REFLEC BEAT colette, it is unlocked by reaching the Goal of Pastel Adventure (パステルアドベンチャー) in limelight Mountain.
From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, quaver♪ was available by default.
songs.songConnections:
A rock remix of quaver♪, titled quaver♪ ギタドラ ver., appears in GITADORA.

A long version of quaver♪ appears in dj TAKA's second album, True Blue....
This long version also includes quaver♪ ギタドラ ver. on its middle part.

quaver♪ appears as part of the medley The 5th KAC DJ TOTTO's SELECTION, from REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA.

Beastie Starter's EXTREME chart is the second song (after ねこバス ～となりのトトロ～), and the first arcade chart to pass the 1000-note mark.

Beastie Starter could be unlocked from February 27th, 2013 to March 3rd, 2014 in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro and 21 SPADA as part of the Café de Tran unlock system. songs.songConnections: Beastie Starter is 10 BPM faster than GUHROOVY's previous jubeat song, AIR RAID FROM THA UNDAGROUND, starting a tradition of each GUHROOVY speedcore song being 10 BPM faster than its predecessor.

songs.title: †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†
songs.titleNorm: †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ~レイディオ†
trivia: †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† is the final unlock of jubeat saucer's bistro saucer 2nd Set. It could be unlocked from November 1st to 30th, 2012 after all other 2nd Set songs are unlocked. It was also the only brand new KONAMI original song in jubeat saucer in November.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it is part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 51.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
†渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† marks Mayumi Morinaga's first use of her Prim alias on the jubeat series.

†渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† can be unlocked in REFLEC BEAT colette -Spring- from April 1st, 2013 as part of the Pastel-kun to Smith-shi no RUNRUN marathon! (パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event with jubeat saucer. It is the third unlockable song of the 2nd Meeting, after Smith completes 35 laps around the track. From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† was playable by default.

†渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† was added to DanceDanceRevolution (2013) on August 28th, 2013 as part of the jubeat・GITADORA・DDRのTriple Journey unlock event, which started on August 1st, 2013. To unlock †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† on DanceDanceRevolution (2013), you must go to its eAMUSEMENT GATE page, then go to the "HOW TO PLAY" section. Under the tutorial on style selection, EMI's face on the Double Play pose is replaced with Smith's face; click on it and the picture that appears.
†渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† is the only song to be transplanted as part of events between jubeat saucer and other BEMANI games, to all of those other games.

†渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† [ 2 ] can be unlocked in jubeat prop's Step unlocking system, by reaching Step Level 75. These charts were added to jubeat plus as alternate Hold Marker charts for †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† on October 29th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
songs.songConnections:
An instrumental version of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†, titled †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†(カラオケ), can be downloaded from the Chakushin★uta♪ (着信★うた♪) service.

A rock arrangement of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†, titled †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† (GITADORA ver.), appears in GITADORA.

A remix of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† by Ryu☆, titled †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ〜レイディオ† (Ryu☆Mix), appears in Mayumi Morinaga's second album, Din Don Dan.

Another remix of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† by ARM, titled †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† - ARM remix -, appears in ARM's ファンタジックぴこれーしょん! album.

Another remix of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† by kors k, titled †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† (STARDOM Remix), appears in DANCERUSH STARDOM.

A chiptune arrangement of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ† by Saitone, titled †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†-CHIPTRO_mix-, appears in the beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE exclusive album BEMANI 8bit collection.

The ノスタルジア series uses a slightly different version of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†, featuring additional piano arrangement by red glasses.

A sequel to †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†, titled †渚のリベンジΣ脈あり!?バケェ～ション†, appears in jubeat Ave..

songs.title: 紅焔
trivia: 紅焔 was the winner of the つぎドカ! event, and later appeared as one of jubeat saucer's Only Now Songs (いまだけ楽曲). It could be unlocked from January 9th to February 1st, 2013. From February 2nd, 2013, it could be unlocked via bistro saucer.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it is part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 99.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
紅焔's jubeat charts were written by T_da.
紅焔's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

Both 紅焔 and Cosmic Hurricane appeared on the first location tests of pop'n music Sunny Park and REFLEC BEAT colette. However, both songs did not appear when those games were released. Instead, 紅焔 and Cosmic Hurricane appeared on December 19th, 2012 as part of the Tsugidoka! (つぎドカ!) event. This makes 紅焔 and Cosmic Hurricane the only songs part of a cross-BEMANI game event to be revealed as early as the participating games' location tests.
紅焔 marks Daichi Watanabe's first song under his main PON alias in the DanceDanceRevolution series.
紅焔 received a brand-new set of charts in the final release of pop'n music Sunny Park.
"Kouen" (紅焔) is Japanese for "crimson flame". The title is a pun on 公園 (also read as "kouen"), which is Japanese for "park".
紅焔 was performed live on the pop'n music 20 fantasia original soundtrack Release Event, where PON introduced it as a "PON new song".

A 3P palette for RETSU is available by inputting the code found on the pop'n music Sunny Park original soundtrack vol.2 album. The code must be inputted at the final e-AMUSEMENT screen, where your already unlocked Secret Characters are shown. From pop'n music éclale onwards, this 3P palette is available by default.
songs.songConnections:
The PON BGM in REFLEC BEAT colette is based on 紅焔.

Much like 水鏡, 雷君, and 流離 represent water, thunder, and sand attributes respectively, 紅焔 represents fire.

A sequel to 紅焔, titled 煌-灼熱の裁き-, can be found in pop'n music ラピストリア.

A long version of 紅焔 can be found on PON's first album, Power Of Nature.

A live version of 紅焔 was performed at the EXIT TUNES Dance Party -beatnation RHYZE music council- event. It was later added to pop'n music ラピストリア as 紅焔(Live Version).

An instrumental version of 紅焔, titled 紅焔(カラオケ), can be downloaded from the Chakushin★uta♪ (着信★うた♪) service.
It can also be found in the SOUND VOLTEX FLOOR website as an "audition" song for the Continuing the Seniors! The Second Vocalist Contest (先輩に続け！第2回ボーカリストコンテスト).

songs.title: Plan 8
trivia: Plan 8 could be unlocked from February 27th, 2013 to March 3rd, 2014 in jubeat saucer as part of the Café de Tran unlock system. It was the sixth unlockable song for that game. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from May 1st, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.

In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
Plan 8's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

Plan 8 is the ONE MORE EXTRA STAGE song of the LEGEND CROSS event in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro. To unlock it, you must EX-HARD Clear Thor's Hammer with a AAA rank to access this song. As of November 7th, 2012, Plan 8 is accessed by clearing Thor's Hammer with any type of gauge, under specific rank conditions depending on the difficulty chosen. All the charts are accessible.
In beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA, its NORMAL, HYPER, and ANOTHER charts can be unlocked by obtaining 52, 60, and 68 Tran Medals respectively.
As of December 19th, 2013, it is unlocked by default.
When Plan 8 is played as a boss stage in LEGEND CROSS, the arcade LED ticker displays "RED BOSS 12".
Plan 8 is Ryu☆'s first ONE MORE EXTRA STAGE song since 3y3s in beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS.
songs.songConnections:
Plan 8's title is related to other non-BEMANI songs by Ryu☆, Plan A, Plan B, Plan C and Plan E.

According to Ryu☆, Plan 8's second half comes from an earlier song of his called Theme of Plan 8, a song he produced back in 1997 under his Plan 8 unit in school (see Trivia).

The second half of Plan 8 is of a lower key in the beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK Vol.1 album, compared with the game version. It is also slightly shorter, cutting one measure of the breakdown.
The OST version of Plan 8 is used in the DanceDanceRevolution and jubeat series.

The version of Plan 8 found in Ryu☆'s fourth compilation album, Ryu☆BEST -SILVERLiGHT-, is based on the in-game version found in the beatmania IIDX and SOUND VOLTEX series.

A long version of Plan 8, titled Plan 8 (Extended Mix), appears in Ryu☆'s fifth album of the same name. It is based on the beatmania IIDX version of the song.
The second half of Plan 8 (Extended Mix) samples part of the melody from starmine.

A piano arrangement of Plan 8 by wac, titled Plan 8 の主題による8つの変奏曲, appears in the beatnation Records presents "We're so Happy" special remix CD, which can be obtained by pre-ordering We're so Happy in KONAMI STYLE.

A remix of Plan 8 by RoughSketch, titled Plan 8 (RoughSketch Remix), appears in Ryu☆'s compilation album, Ryu☆BEST -STARLiGHT-.

Another remix of Plan 8 by Camellia, titled Plan 8 (Camellia's "From Inner Cosmos" Remix), appears in Ryu☆'s third best-of album, Ryu☆BEST -SUNLiGHT-.

songs.title: Confiserie
trivia: Confiserie could be unlocked from February 27th, 2013 to March 3rd, 2014 in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro, beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA, and jubeat saucer as part of the Café de Tran unlock system. It was the final unlockable song for both games. To unlock it, you must have unlocked all the other 6 Café de Tran songs in both beatmania IIDX and jubeat. In beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA, it could also be unlocked via the 発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡 event from July 24th, 2014. In beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL, it could be unlocked by purchasing the Café de Tran Youkou no hologram (陽光のホログラム) from July 1st, 2015.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from May 1st, 2014. In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.

In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART. It could also be unlocked in jubeat festo from April 7th to June 29th, 2021 as part of the Stamp Challenge unlocking system, by obtaining 3 stamps.
In jubeat Ave., it can be unlocked in the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system, after having unlocked Liar×Girl.

Confiserie marks the first collaboration between Toshiyuki Kakuta and Shigeharu Saeki in BEMANI. Both Toshiyuki Kakuta and Shigeharu Saeki are sound directors of beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro and jubeat saucer, respectively.

With 919 notes, Confiserie's ADVANCED chart has the fourth highest number of notes of an ADVANCED chart in the jubeat series, behind Thanatøs's 1049, Crackpot Evangelist's 1039, and XENOViA's 923 notes. Confiserie's ADVANCED chart is also the second ADVANCED chart rated Level 10, after yellow head joe.
Confiserie's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
As of beatmania IIDX 23 copula, it is available by default.

With 1021 notes, Confiserie's EXTREME chart is the second arcade chart to pass the 1000-note mark, after Beastie Starter. Also, Confiserie's BASIC chart has the fifth highest number of notes of any BASIC chart, with 542 notes.
Confiserie is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.4 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.4).

songs.title: Arousing
trivia: Arousing is one of jubeat saucer's Only Now Songs (いまだけ楽曲). It could be unlocked from June 1st to 12th, 2013. It was the only new KONAMI original in jubeat saucer in June that was not (initially) part of an event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
Arousing marks Yoshihiro Tagawa's first original composition in the jubeat series, as well as his first vocal song. It also marks vocalist Sunao Yoshikawa's first BEMANI song without kors k.
Arousing's jubeat charts were created by MICHI [1].

Arousing can be unlocked in REFLEC BEAT colette -Spring- from June 12th, 2013 as part of the Pastel-kun to Smith-shi no RUNRUN marathon! (パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event with jubeat saucer. It is the first unlockable song of the 3rd Meeting, after Smith completes 15 laps around the track. From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, Arousing was playable by default.

Arousing was the only non-event KONAMI original song introduced to jubeat saucer on June 2013 that wasn't included in a jubeat plus pack until it finally made its debut in the saucer fulfill pack 6 on February 20th, 2015.
Arousing was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.
Arousing's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
From June 13th, 2013, it could be unlocked via bistro saucer.
In REFLEC BEAT +, Arousing's artist is romanized.
songs.songConnections: A rock arrangement of Arousing is used in GITADORA NEX+AGE. This version has never appeared in any soundtrack.

trivia: Sakura Sunrise is the final unlock of jubeat saucer's bistro saucer 6th Set. It could be unlocked from April 1st to 30th, 2013 after all other 6th Set songs are unlocked. It is the first bistro saucer final song in jubeat saucer that is a BEMANI crossover.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it is part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 57.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.

Sakura Sunrise [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE. It could be purchased with 200 T-emo from June 3rd to July 1st, 2019. It could be purchased again with 100 T-emo from December 2nd, 2019 to January 6th, 2020, and from May 7th to July 6th, 2020.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
Sakura Sunrise's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

Sakura Sunrise is one of the Replicant D-action hidden songs in DanceDanceRevolution X2, representing the color green. To play Sakura Sunrise as a Replicant D-action song, you must clear at least 2 songs in each game folder (24 at least total). As of February 23rd, 2011, Sakura Sunrise has been unlocked for normal play.

Prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, Sakura Sunrise's music video is shown in the background of a light blue-colored version of the REPLICANT background dance stage and is not full-screen. In DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5, Sakura Sunrise's video removes any on-screen dancers and is played in a tiny monitor on the opposite side of the player on Single and in the center on Double/Versus, due to Nintendo Wii memory limitations.
This video reuses four DDRMAX-EXTREME background movies.
Sakura Sunrise marks Ryutaro Nakahara's first original song for an arcade DanceDanceRevolution release. It also marks his first EXTRA STAGE song in DanceDanceRevolution.

In the Japanese arcade version of DanceDanceRevolution X2, Sakura Sunrise had a slightly different jacket with a different font for "Ryu☆". This jacket is also used in the BeatStream and DANCE aROUND series.
songs.songConnections:
An extended version of Sakura Sunrise, titled Sakura Sunrise (Extended RRver.), appears in Ryu☆'s third album, Rainbow☆Rainbow.

Another extended version of Sakura Sunrise, titled Sakura Sunrise (SUNLiGHT Mix), can be found on Ryu☆'s third best of album, Ryu☆BEST -SUNLiGHT-.

Sakura Sunrise is part of Ryu☆'s "Sakura" song series.

A rock arrangement of Sakura Sunrise, titled Sakura Sunrise (GITADORA ver.), appears in GITADORA.

A piano arrangement of Sakura Sunrise appears in ノスタルジア FORTE.
Parts of sakura storm and Sakura Luminance's melodies can be heard in the middle of this version of Sakura Sunrise.

songs.title: New Decade
trivia: New Decade was added to jubeat saucer on August 4th, 2013, as part of the jubeat・GITADORA・DDRのTriple Journey unlock event, which started on August 1st, 2013. To unlock New Decade on jubeat saucer, you have to "draw" one of the four arrows pointing towards any of the 4 corners during the Online Matching screen.

After the event ended, it can be unlocked in jubeat saucer via the bistro saucer unlocking event. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
From jubeat beyond the Ave. onwards, it is available by default with an e-amusement pass.
New Decade received a new jacket in the jubeat series. It has a similar style done like VOLTEXES, a song from REFLEC BEAT colette -Winter- also made by Sota Fujimori.
New Decade's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
New Decade [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of jubeat beyond the Ave.'s LIGHT CHAT unlocking system. It can be unlocked from release date.

New Decade is one of the Replicant D-action hidden songs in DanceDanceRevolution X2, representing the color orange. To play New Decade as a Replicant D-action song, you must obtain a full combo on 15 different charts (can be the same songs), then obtain a AA/AAA rank on Sakura Sunrise and Shiny World on the same difficulty. As of February 23rd, 2011, New Decade has been unlocked for normal play.
songs.songConnections:
A long version of New Decade, titled New Decade -Extended Mix-, appears in Sota Fujimori's third album, SYNTHESIZED3.
This full version of New Decade is also playable in DanceDanceRevolution II.

New Decade IIDX Edition, which appears in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro, is based on this long version.

New Decade and New Decade IIDX Edition share the "かっこいい~~" (kakkoii~~) sample with another Sota Fujimori song, [E].

New Decade shares two soundbites with TRIP MACHINE, one of them being the "DDR" vocal sample.

New Decade is part of Sota Fujimori's "New" song series.

A remixed mashup of BREDLI and New Decade by U1-ASAMi, titled 新蛇姫, appears in DanceDanceRevolution A3 and DANCERUSH STARDOM.

In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
Go For The Top's jubeat charts were created by RAG [1].
Go For The Top's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
Go For The Top appears as the July 1st, 2023 "Today's recommended song" (きょうのオススメ楽曲) in jubeat Ave. to promote the semifinals and finals of BEMANI PRO LEAGUE SEASON 2's DanceDanceRevolution division.
Go For The Top was one of the preliminary round songs in the KONAMI Arcade Championship 2012 for DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX. It was added as a default song on October 15th, 2012.

songs.songConnections:
A remix of Go For The Top, titled Go For The Top (Grand Finale Mix), appears on the DanceDanceRevolution Original Soundtrack Vol.1 album.
A slightly remixed, shorter version of Go For The Top (Grand Finale Mix), titled Go For ㋟♫ Top, appears in ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom.

A Christmas themed remix of Go For The Top, titled Go For The Top (Xmas For Only You), could be found on the DanceDanceRevolution (2014) website, located where the YuniverHills project (ユニバーヒルズproject) section was.

heron's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
heron is Shigeharu Saeki's first original song in the DanceDanceRevolution series.

A rock arrangement of heron by OJ, titled heron -GITADOROCK ver.-, can be found in GITADORA.

Clumsy thoughts is the first unlockable song of the Pastel Adventure colette Mountain 1 event of REFLEC BEAT colette -Winter-. From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, Clumsy thoughts was playable by default.

songs.title: この青空の下で
trivia: この青空の下で can be unlocked in jubeat saucer from April 1st, 2013 as part of the Pastel-kun to Smith-shi no RUNRUN marathon! (パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event with REFLEC BEAT colette. この青空の下で's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
この青空の下で was added to REFLEC BEAT limelight on July 27th, 2012.
この青空の下で is Yasuhiro Taguchi's first song with eimy as the vocalist.
In REFLEC BEAT + and jukebeat, この青空の下で's title was changed to Into the blue.

この青空の下で can be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution (2014) from December 24th, 2015 via EXTRA ATTACK as part of the OSB～Winter★Special★Present～ (OSB～ウィンター★スペシャル★プレゼント～) event. Note that the SURVIVED BONUS meter has to be filled on BEGINNER, then BASIC, DIFFICULT, and then finally EXPERT. In DanceDanceRevolution A, it can be unlocked through EXTRA SAVIOR.

songs.title: anemone
trivia: anemone can be unlocked in jubeat saucer and REFLEC BEAT colette -Spring- from April 1st, 2013 as part of the Pastel-kun to Smith-shi no RUNRUN marathon! (パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event. It is the fourth and final unlockable song of the 1st Meeting, after both Pastel-kun and Smith complete 40 laps around the track. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from May 1st, 2014. In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
anemone marks the first collaboration between S-C-U and Qrispy Joybox in BEMANI. Both are the sound directors of jubeat saucer and REFLEC BEAT colette respectively.
anemone's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
In REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! and REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper, anemone could be purchased at the REFLEC Shop for 1000 Refle. In REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA and REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, it was available by default.

The Anemone is a genus of about 120 species of flowering plants in the family Ranunculaceae, native to the temperate zones. They are perennials that have basal leaves with long leaf-stems that can be upright or prostrate.
After being removed from the initial release of REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア, anemone was revived on August 16th, 2018.
