(パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event with REFLEC BEAT colette. It can be unlocked by playing 4 games of REFLEC BEAT colette. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from May 1st, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
From jubeat beyond the Ave. onwards, it is available by default with an e-amusement pass.

To unlock VALLIS-NERIA in jubeat plus, you must have purchased the three RUNRUNマラソン！ packs in jubeat plus. Then, you can download the song by tapping the Gift button at the Store. Since August 5th, 2016, it can be downloaded without any requisites.

VALLIS-NERIA [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE. It could be purchased with 300 T-emo from December 2nd, 2019 to January 6th, 2020. It could be purchased again with 150 T-emo from June 1st to July 6th, 2020, and from September 7th to October 5th, 2020.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
VALLIS-NERIA's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
VALLIS-NERIA and VALLIS-NERIA [ 2 ] were added to jubeat (2021)'s normal mode on March 30th, 2022.
songs.songConnections:
VALLIS-NERIA is part of DJ YOSHITAKA's JOMANDA song series.

A symphonic medley of JOMANDA, VALLIS-NERIA, and Lisa-RICCIA by onoken, titled JOMANDA・VALLIS-NERIA・Lisa-RICCIA (Orchestra Arr.) スペシャルメドレー, can be found on the BEMANI SYMPHONY ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album.
A short version of the VALLIS-NERIA part of the above medley, titled VALLIS-NERIA (BEMANI SYMPHONY NOSTALGIA mix), appears in ノスタルジア Op.3.

songs.title: Lisa-RICCIA
trivia: Lisa-RICCIA can be unlocked in jubeat saucer and REFLEC BEAT colette -Autumn- from November 13th, 2013 as part of the Pastel-kun to Smith-shi no RUNRUN marathon! (パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event. It is the unlockable song of the Mission DELTA, after both Pastel-kun and Smith-shi complete 40 laps around the track. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from May 1st, 2014. In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.

Lisa-RICCIA marks Yoshitaka Nishimura's first non-BEMANI crossover/collaboration to be in a core jubeat game (as opposed to the APPEND games) since Evans from the original jubeat. It's also his second song to simultaneously debut in jubeat and REFLEC BEAT, after FLOWER in jubeat knit APPEND and REFLEC BEAT.
Lisa-RICCIA is the last brand-new KONAMI original in jubeat saucer. The last one made exclusively for jubeat saucer, though, is Gimme a Big Beat.

To unlock Lisa-RICCIA in jubeat plus or REFLEC BEAT plus, you must have purchased the three RUNRUNマラソン！ packs in jubeat plus or REFLEC BEAT plus respectively. Then, you can download the song by tapping the Gift button at the Store. Since August 5th, 2016, it can be downloaded without any requisites.
Lisa-RICCIA's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

Lisa-RICCIA is the DELTA unlock of DanceDanceRevolution WORLD's GALAXY BRAVE unlock event. It can be unlocked from July 9th, 2026. The name of its GALAXY BRAVE Trial Room, DELTA, is a reference to the fact it was the unlockable song of the Mission DELTA in the パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン! event for both jubeat saucer and REFLEC BEAT colette -Autumn-. The song selection for this Trial Room is also based on said event, with spring pony representing the 1st Annual Meeting, Broken representing the 2nd Annual Meeting, and Windy Fairy representing the 3rd Annual Meeting (DJ TOTTO Meeting).
From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, Lisa-RICCIA could be purchased at the REFLEC Shop for 1000 Refle.
Riccia is a genus of liverworts in the order Marchantiales.

Both JOMANDA's and VALLIS-NERIA's jacket characters appear in the background of Lisa-RICCIA's jacket. Lisa-RICCIA's jacket character made a brief appearance in the beatmania IIDX video of VALLIS-NERIA before Lisa-RICCIA itself was released.
Lisa-RICCIA is currently DJ Yoshitaka's latest solo song in BEMANI.

After being removed from the initial release of REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア, Lisa-RICCIA was revived on November 2nd, 2017. Its WHITE HARD chart could be unlocked through a quest in Reflesia Mode (リフレシアモード) from November 9th to 22nd, 2017. Since March 8th, 2018, it is available by default.
songs.songConnections:
Lisa-RICCIA is part of DJ YOSHITAKA's JOMANDA song series.

A remix of Lisa-RICCIA by DJ Genki, titled Lisa-RICCIA(DJ Genki Remix), appears in the beatnation RHYZE vs HARDCORE TANO*C album.

A symphonic medley of JOMANDA, VALLIS-NERIA, and Lisa-RICCIA by onoken, titled JOMANDA・VALLIS-NERIA・Lisa-RICCIA (Orchestra Arr.) スペシャルメドレー, can be found on the BEMANI SYMPHONY ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album.
A short version of the Lisa-RICCIA part of the above medley, titled Lisa-RICCIA (BEMANI SYMPHONY Arr.), appears in jubeat (2021).

A remastered version of Lisa-RICCIA was performed at the EDP × beatnation summit 2025 event held on October 12th, 2025.
It is included as Lisa-RICCIA -Comeback Update- in the cyber beatnation 3 -non-stop best conclusion- album released on the same day.

This version is later used in the beatmania IIDX and DanceDanceRevolution series.

The alias used by Jun Wakita in ストレイ・マーチ, Shounen Zodiac (少年ゾディアック), is a combination of his Shounen Radio (少年ラジオ) and ZODIACSYNDICATE aliases.
ストレイ・マーチ is Jun Wakita's first non-collaboration original song in the REFLEC BEAT series. It also marks the first original song by Yu Tokiwa in the REFLEC BEAT series.

ストレイ・マーチ appears in pop'n music Sunny Park as part of the Q-pro, Mimi, Nyami & Pastel-kun no minna de uchuu sensou!! (クプロ・ミミニャミ・パステルくんのみんなで宇宙戦争!!) unlock event, which started on July 29th, 2013. From July 23rd, 2015, it could be unlocked in pop'n music ラピストリア via Story Mode.
songs.songConnections:
ストレイ・マーチ is part of wac's Zodiac song series, representing Aries.

The ノスタルジア series uses a slightly rearranged version of ストレイ・マーチ.

songs.title: Wow Wow VENUS
trivia: On April 1st, 2013, as an April Fool's Day joke, Wow Wow VENUS was shown by KONAMI to be the final unlockable song of the RUNRUN marathon crossover event for jubeat saucer and REFLEC BEAT colette -Spring-, after completing 573 million rounds around the track with Pastel-kun. Also, parts of Wow Wow VENUS' jacket were randomly shown at jubeat saucer's eAMUSEMENT GATE. Despite that joke, Wow Wow VENUS is one of jubeat saucer's Only Now Songs (いまだけ楽曲). It could be unlocked from April 2nd to 9th, 2013. From April 10th, 2013, it could be unlocked via bistro saucer.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it is part of the Step unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 93.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.

Wow Wow VENUS' jubeat charts were created by MICHI [1]. The "VENUS" pattern seen in Wow Wow VENUS's jubeat charts (lower left corner, top right corner, the panels vertically- and horizontally-adjacent to the latter) would appear again in Brand New World's jubeat charts.
Wow Wow VENUS marks the first appearance of Sota Fujimori and Yoshitaka Nishimura as VENUS in jubeat and DanceDanceRevolution.
Wow Wow VENUS was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.
Wow Wow VENUS's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

Wow Wow VENUS and みんな笑った are the first unlocks of the first Phase of REFLEC BEAT colette -Spring-'s Pastel Adventure colette Garden unlocking system. Both songs are obtainable at the start of colette Garden. From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, Wow Wow VENUS was playable by default.
Wow Wow VENUS, much like the other VENUS songs, is part of an inside joke.

U1-ASAMi was in charge of the photoshoot for Wow Wow VENUS' jacket. The photoshoot for Wow Wow VENUS as well as UNLIMITED FIRE-Try to Sing Ver.- were the first tasks he did for the REFLEC BEAT series.
Wow Wow VENUS is the first VENUS song composed by DJ YOSHITAKA instead of Sota Fujimori.
songs.songConnections:
Part of Wow Wow VENUS' lyrics, "Without you tonight", are also Survival Games' first lyrics.
WITHOUT YOU TONIGHT is also Brand New World's genre.

The VENUS BGM in REFLEC BEAT colette is based on Wow Wow VENUS.

An extended version of Wow Wow VENUS appears in VENUS' ZEUS mini-album and in their first album, DEUS.
An instrumental long version, titled Wow Wow VENUS -Instrumental-, also appears in ZEUS.

An instrumental game size version of Wow Wow VENUS appears in the SOUND VOLTEX FLOOR official website as an "audition" song for the Continuing the Seniors! The Second Vocalist Contest (先輩に続け！第2回ボーカリストコンテスト).

A cover of Wow Wow VENUS by SOUND HOLIC feat. Nana Takahashi & 709sec. appears in SOUND HOLIC's 焔 -MAGMA- album.

Another cover of Wow Wow VENUS, titled Wow Wow VENUS (乾セナ Cover), appears in ポラリスコード.

A remake of Wow Wow VENUS, titled Wow Wow VENUS 2026, appears in pop'n music High☆Cheers!!.

songs.title: Elemental Creation
trivia: In jubeat saucer, it could be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking system. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it could be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it could be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default.

Elemental Creation's jubeat charts were created by RAG [1]. At the time when Elemental Creation came out, jubeat's bonus score calculation formula couldn't handle a chart with more than 1024 notes (players would need to almost get an all PERFECT or GREAT to get a full bonus score). This makes Elemental Creation's EXTREME chart essentially having the max notecount at that time, with 1023 notes. This bug could be seen in Elemental Creation -GITADO ROCK ver.-'s EXTREME chart in jubeat plus, which has 1038 notes. The bug was later fixed.
Elemental Creation's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

Elemental Creation is the final Shiritsu BEMANI gakuen (私立BEMANI学園) song. To unlock it, you must first have unlocked all the other 9 Shiritsu BEMANI gakuen songs, and then get 100% of Friendship on dj TAKA and DJ YOSHITAKA. After the event ended, it can be unlocked through different systems, depending on the BEMANI game: In beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA, it could be automatically unlocked after 30 play sessions until July 24th, 2014. From July 24th, 2014 up until June 25th, 2015, it could be unlocked via the 発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡 event in beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA and beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL.
Since July 1st, 2015 in beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL, it could be obtained by purchasing the BEMANI学園 pack (which includes all 私立BEMANI学園 songs) for 7000 FRICO.
From beatmania IIDX 23 copula onwards, it is available by default.

In DanceDanceRevolution (2013) and DanceDanceRevolution (2014), it could be automatically unlocked after 10 play sessions. Its CHALLENGE charts could be unlocked after a play session after having unlocked Elemental Creation. From DanceDanceRevolution A onwards, Elemental Creation and its CHALLENGE charts are available by default.

In pop'n music Sunny Park, it could be unlocked in the Waiwai pop'n doubutsuen (わいわいポップン動物園) unlocking event from December 19th, 2013. In pop'n music ラピストリア, it could be unlocked via Story Mode from July 9th, 2014.
In pop'n music éclale, it could be purchased from the Star Factory shop for 100 lumina.
As of pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢, it is available by default.
songs.songConnections:
Elemental Creation samples a third quarter part of Westminster Quarters, the chiming melody used in the Palace of Westminster.

A rock arrangement of Elemental Creation featuring guitars by good-cool, titled Elemental Creation -GITADO ROCK ver.-, appears in GITADORA.

A remix of Elemental Creation by kamome sano, titled Elemental Creation (kamome sano Remix), appears in SOUND VOLTEX VIVID WAVE.
Another remix by uma meets モリモリあつし, titled Re：Elemental Creation, also appears in SOUND VOLTEX VIVID WAVE.

Another remix of Elemental Creation by xi, titled Elemental Creation -xiRemix-, appears in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR.

A slightly rearranged version of Elemental Creation is used in the ノスタルジア series, featuring additional piano arrangement by Jun Wakita.

songs.title: sola
trivia: sola was added to both DanceDanceRevolution (2013) and jubeat saucer on August 1st, 2013 as part of the jubeat・GITADORA・DDRのTriple Journey unlock event. It is the first unlock in the event for both games. To unlock sola, you must just read the first mail and click on the unlocking button on the Triple Journey official site.

After the event ended, it can be unlocked in jubeat saucer via the bistro saucer unlocking event. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
sola's jubeat charts were created by MICHI [1].

sola [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE. It could be purchased with 200 T-emo from January 7th to February 4th, 2019. It could be purchased again with 150 T-emo from January 6th to February 3rd, 2020.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
sola's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

From October 1st, 2013, it could be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution (2013) and DanceDanceRevolution (2014) by playing one round with an eAMUSEMENT PASS. From DanceDanceRevolution A onwards, sola is playable by default.
sola is Hideyuki Ono's only original composition for the DanceDanceRevolution series.
"Sola" is a corruption of "sora" (空), which is Japanese for "sky".
On sola's jacket and in jukebeat, sola's artist is romanized as Hideyuki Ono.
songs.songConnections: A rock remix of sola, titled sola GITADORA ver. and credited to 小野秀幸×96, appears in GITADORA.

(パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event. It is the fourth and final unlockable song of the 3rd Annual Meeting, after both Pastel-kun and Smith complete 60 laps around the track. chaplet's jubeat charts were created by RAG [1].

chaplet is one of DanceDanceRevolution A3's EXTRA SAVIOR A3 songs. It can be unlocked from March 23rd, 2023 for 20th anniversary model cabinets, and from March 27th, 2023 for regular cabinets. As of DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, it is available by default.

chaplet appears as part of the medley The 6th KAC DJ TOTTO's SELECTION, from REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア.

trivia: Snowfield Express marks TIME CAPSULE Lab.'s debut in pop'n music and jubeat. It is also TIME CAPSULE Lab.'s first BEMANI song that isn't part of his elementary particle song series, which includes photon, Lepton and Graviton.

Snowfield Express is one of the songs part of the Mimi, Nyami & Kotaro no flying catch! (ミミニャミ・コタローのフライングキャッチ！) event. It can be unlocked in jubeat saucer since June 3rd, 2013. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from May 1st, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART. It could also be unlocked from December 7th, 2020 to January 4th, 2021 as one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE.

In snowboarding and skateboarding, an ollie is a trick where the rider and board leap into the air without the use of the rider's hands.
According to とっきー, OLLIE was supposed to wear a hat and a long-sleeved jacket originally, but scrapped both for a simpler design that allowed him for more movement.
Snowfield Express is available in pop'n music Lively by purchasing pop'n music Lively Music Pack vol.6 (pop'n music Lively 楽曲パック vol.6).

Brand New World's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat clan ratings on March 7th, 2022.
Brand New World is VENUS' first original song outside the REFLEC BEAT series. It is also the first VENUS song not to debut or co-debut in the REFLEC BEAT series.
Brand New World's character, VENUS, is based on both Sota Fujimori (performing the keyboard) and Yoshitaka Nishimura (performing vocals).
Brand New World is the first Sota Fujimori song in pop'n music with male vocals.

Brand New World was one of the hidden songs from REFLEC BEAT colette -Autumn- since November 9th, 2013. To unlock it, you had to play only VENUS songs before reaching the FINAL ROUND. Note that the game didn't warn the player about Brand New World being unlocked. Brand New World is permanently unlocked for everyone to play on November 11th, 2013.
songs.songConnections:
Brand New World's genre, WITHOUT YOU TONIGHT, are also the first lyrics to another VENUS song, Survival Games.

An extended version of Brand New World, titled Brand New World -Extended Mix-, appears on VENUS' mini-album, ZEUS (bundled with REFLEC BEAT colette ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK VOL.2), as well on VENUS' first album, DEUS.
An instrumental version of Brand New World's extended version, titled Brand New World -Instrumental-, also appears on VENUS' mini-album ZEUS.

The "Yeah! Yeah!" line is sampled in Squeeze.

songs.title: Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION-
trivia: Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION- was added to jubeat saucer on August 31st, 2013 as the final song of the jubeat・GITADORA・DDRのTriple Journey unlock event. To unlock Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION- on jubeat saucer, you must have read all of the previous days' mails on the Triple Journey official site, then read the August 31st mail and click on the unlocking button.

After the event ended, it can be unlocked in jubeat saucer via the bistro saucer unlocking event. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
The jubeat・GITADORA・DDRのTriple Journey's characters, Smith, OTOBEAR and BABY-LON, appear in Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION-'s jacket.

Its EXTREME chart's pattern references all of the unlocking methods of the previous unlockable songs in jubeat saucer in the jubeat・GITADORA・DDRのTriple Journey event in order of their appearance: Arrow-shaped patterns are a reference to New Decade's unlock method.
Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION-'s jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION-'s charts were created by まっする [1]. Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION- is the first song to have both its ADVANCED and EXTREME charts rated Level 9.
"S", "C", and "U" patterns are a reference to キケンな果実's unlock method.
Telephone-shaped pattern is a reference to 万華鏡's unlock method.
"C" and "D" patterns are a reference to Straight Oath's unlock method.
"L" and "V" patterns and patterns of 5, 7, and 3 simultaneous notes (for LEVEL 573) are a reference to heron's unlock method.
songs.songConnections:
Triple Journey -S-C-U EDITION- is one of the three Triple Journey songs, each one of them arranged by the sound director of the game where it debuted. The other Triple Journey songs are:
Triple Journey -OJ EDITION-, which appears in GITADORA.

Triple Journey -TAG EDITION-, which appears in DanceDanceRevolution (2013).

To unlock Right on time (Ryu☆ Remix) on jubeat saucer, you must click on the 08/21 date from the calendar in jubeat saucer's eAMUSEMENT site, and then click on the image that appears. After the event ended, it can be unlocked in jubeat saucer via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.

ほしふり is the first appearance of Sanae Shintani in the GuitarFreaks & DrumMania series in over a decade, and her only original song for the series. It's also her only collaboration with Asaki in BEMANI.

ほしふり is a GDP-unlockable song in GuitarFreaks V7 & DrumMania V7 as of March 25th, 2010, and is one of the few XG songs that appeared in V7 first. The song is unlocked at 10000 GDP. ほしふり is automatically unlocked in GuitarFreaksXG & DrumManiaXG as of April 29th, 2010.
Data for an unused Bass EXTREME chart for ほしふり can be found in GuitarFreaks V7.
ほしふり's video was replaced by a generic video in GuitarFreaksXG2 & DrumManiaXG2 Groove to Live. This change was reverted in GITADORA.

ほしふり uses Sana Coffret's album jacket in the REFLEC BEAT series.
In jukebeat, ほしふり's title was romanized as hoshifuri.

A re-interpretation of both ほしふり and 極東史記, titled ほしふりの果て　極東史記より, appears on Asaki's second album, 天庭.

A remastered version of ほしふり, titled ほしふり　Re:pray, appears in pop'n music ラピストリア.

After the app check, Engraved Mark will be fully unlocked in Collection Mode.
To unlock it in jubeat plus or REFLEC BEAT plus, you must tap the Present button on the Music Store. After the app check, Engraved Mark will be available to play.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from August 26th, 2014. In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.

In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.

To unlock it in ポップンリズミン, you must accept the present at the main screen. After the app check, Engraved Mark will be available in GAME MODE.

songs.title: SHION
trivia: SHION is the ninth unlockable song of jubeat saucer fulfill's saucer macchiato SEASON 1 unlocking system. In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
SHION's jubeat charts were created by MICHI [1].
SHION's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
Shion (シオン) is the Japanese name of a flower commonly known as Aster tataricus, which is associated with memory and remembrance. The word shion itself can be translated out as "I won't forget you".

According to Chihiro, SHION was originally named Zion, after the Japanese period of weather known as the sankan-shion (三寒四温), a period between the winter and spring seasons where there are three days of cold weather followed up by four days of nice, warm weather. More information can be found here. SHION's 2P palette, which has her in a warmer color palette, is a holdover from her original name.
SHION's songwheel genre (ハイスピード幻想チューン) can be read as "HI-SPEED GENSOU TUNE".

In pop'n music, a 3P palette for SHION is available for inputting the code found at the back of the pop'n music card PC19R012/016. The code must be inputted at the final e-AMUSEMENT screen, where your already unlocked Secret Characters are shown. From pop'n music éclale onwards, this 3P palette is available by default.
SHION is unlocked in REFLEC BEAT limelight by reaching the first part of Glass Stage 3-1. From REFLEC BEAT colette to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, it was available by default.

SHION appears in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro as part of the Q-pro, Mimi, Nyami & Pastel-kun no minna de uchuu sensou!! (クプロ・ミミニャミ・パステルくんのみんなで宇宙戦争!!) unlock event, which started on July 29th, 2013. In beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA and beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL, it could be unlocked through the Hakken! Yomigaetta BEMANI iseki (発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡) event.
From beatmania IIDX 23 copula onwards, it is playable by default.

SHION received a SPECIAL chart in REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!. It could be unlocked from October 16th, 2014 to October 29th, 2014 in the PASTEL WONDER QUEST (パステルワンダークエスト) event of REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!. To unlock it, you must win ten times on Normal difficulty in the Wonder Coliseum (ワンダーコロシアム). From October 30th, 2014, it could be purchased from the REFLEC Shop for 3000 Refle.
songs.songConnections:
A long version of SHION appears in the pop'n music 19 TUNE STREET original soundtrack and pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢 Original Soundtrack 20th Anniversary Edition albums. The opening lyrics and the refrain are sung in English in this version, unlike in the original song.
The lyrics of SHION's long version are credited to Nanako and Kotonone Project, while the composition and arrangement are credited to both Yoshitaka Nishimura and S.S.D.FANTASICA.

An instrumental version of SHION appears in the SOUND VOLTEX FLOOR website as an "audition" song for the VOCAL category in the SDVX × DTM MAGAZINE Collaboration Contest (SDVX × DTM MAGAZINE コラボレーションコンテスト).

A remix of SHION by VENUS, titled SHION（VENUS mix）, appears in pop'n music peace.

Another remix of SHION by HOUJIROU featuring vocals by Dadaco, titled SHION (ロースピード幻想チューン Remix), appears in SOUND VOLTEX VIVID WAVE.

Another remix of SHION by BlackY featuring vocals by Risa Yuzuki, titled SHION -sublimation mix-, appears in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR.

The ノスタルジア series uses a slightly rearranged version of SHION, featuring additional piano arrangement by Jun Wakita.

songs.title: 枝に結ぶ願い
trivia: 枝に結ぶ願い is one of jubeat saucer fulfill's BONUS TUNE songs. It was available for play from August 21st, 2014 exclusively during BONUS TUNE, and it could not be unlocked for regular play. In jubeat prop, it was also exclusively available during BONUS TUNE since release date. From November 30th to December 6th, 2015, it was available for unlock as the FINAL TUNE on the thirteenth week of ARENA MODE.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.
枝に結ぶ願い's jubeat charts were created by MICHI [1].

枝に結ぶ願い [ 2 ] can be unlocked in jubeat Qubell as the Fables of Akhuta STAGE 2 unlock of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system. For more information on the dates it can be unlocked, please see this page. In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART. It could also be unlocked from December 7th, 2020 to January 4th, 2021 as one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE.
It could also be unlocked in jubeat festo from February 10th to March 23rd, 2021 as part of the Stamp Challenge unlocking system, by obtaining 15 stamps.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
枝に結ぶ願い's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
Since January 7th, 2016, it could be unlocked for regular play by playing it once as a BONUS TUNE.
songs.songConnections:
枝に結ぶ願い is the second song of Akhuta's 星宿る空の下で song trilogy.

The ending of 星宿る空の下で is connected to the beginning of 枝に結ぶ願い, and the ending of 枝に結ぶ願い sounds very much like the beginning of 星宿る空の下で.
The two songs' jackets can be connected into one picture.

A long, combined version of both songs, titled 星宿る空の下で　枝に結ぶ願い, appears in the jubeat Qubell ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album. This version was made playable in GITADORA Tri-Boost Re:EVOLVE.

The OST version of 枝に結ぶ願い sounds slightly different compared to the original version of the song; particularly the seventh and eighth verses are quietly sung and the piano is more louder.

枝に結ぶ願い received another new, slightly different version of the song on July 7th, 2016 in jubeat Qubell based on the OST version. This version of the song is also used in 星宿る空の下で　枝に結ぶ願い.

The three BGMs for the Fables of Akhuta QUBE, all made by Akhuta, are completely based on 星宿る空の下で and 枝に結ぶ願い.

Also, the artist is slightly changed to 猫叉Master「jubeat」より.

Ironically, while Scars of FAUNA was the only KONAMI original song added to jubeat in the 天下一音ゲ祭 event, it is also the only song from the event whose EXTREME chart was re-rated to Level 9 in jubeat clan.

In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART (note that unlike other songs, it cannot be obtained through Music Conduction). trivia: FLOWER could be unlocked in jubeat knit APPEND as part of the APPEND FESTIVAL event, by playing さよならトリップ in REFLEC BEAT. By then playing FLOWER in jubeat knit APPEND, the song was available in REFLEC BEAT. In jubeat copious and its APPEND version, it is one of the UFO unlocks of the copious travel unlocking system. FLOWER has slight variations in its jacket depending on which game it appears in. Its jubeat jacket features a blue flower and the rear end of a piglet. The character in FLOWER's jubeat jacket is named Charlie. This jacket is also used in DANCE aROUND, DanceDanceRevolution, SOUND VOLTEX, and ポップンリズミン.

Its REFLEC BEAT jacket features a red flower and the front end of the same piglet. The character in FLOWER's REFLEC BEAT jacket is named Cathleen. This jacket is also used in ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom Ver.2. FLOWER's jubeat and REFLEC BEAT jackets are used as the pop'n music background.
Its MÚSECA jacket features the red flower from the REFLEC BEAT jacket, the rear-facing pig from the jubeat jacket, and MÚSECA sound director Dory's mask in place of Charlie.

FLOWER is the first song to appear in some form in every active BEMANI series at the time of its debut, and has appeared in every BEMANI series that has been active at any time since it debuted. In all, it has appeared in beatmania IIDX, BeatStream, CHUNITHM, DANCE aROUND, DanceDanceRevolution, DanceEvolution, DANCERUSH, GROOVE COASTER, GuitarFreaks & DrumMania, jubeat, maimai, MÚSECA, pop'n music, REFLEC BEAT, SOUND VOLTEX, Synchronica, ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom, ノスタルジア, and 太鼓の達人 (a total of 19 games). As a result, some players consider this an inside joke.

FLOWER's video in beatmania IIDX shows a live performance of DJ YOSHITAKA playing FLOWER at the Rainbow☆Rainbow Release Party held on January 29th, 2012. The intro of the video shows the jubeat version of the FLOWER jacket, while at the end the REFLEC BEAT version is shown.
FLOWER's jubeat and REFLEC BEAT jackets appear in a question in the BEMANI Exam on KONAMI's arcade game QUIZ MAGIC ACADEMY Kenja no tobira (クイズマジックアカデミー 賢者の扉).

FLOWER was crossed over to GROOVE COASTER EX, maimai ORANGE and 太鼓の達人 キミドリVer. on October 29th, 2014 as part of the Tenkaichi otogesai Zenkoku issei nintei taikai (天下一音ゲ祭 全国一斉認定大会) event. In the other music games, FLOWER uses a slightly modified version of its jubeat jacket, adding the jubeat saucer fulfill logo.
Also in the other music games (and the SOUND VOLTEX series as well), the artist was slightly changed to DJ YOSHITAKA「jubeat」より.

songs.title: Megalara Garuda
songs.bpm: 180 (other BEMANI games), 90-180 (DanceDanceRevolution, pop'n music UPPER charts)
trivia: Megalara Garuda can be unlocked in jubeat Qubell as the 掘りすぎ dig RUSH FINAL STAGE 4 unlock of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system. For more information on the dates it can be unlocked, please see this page. In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.

Megalara Garuda was the only jubeat song in the entire series rated Level 10, the highest level, on all difficulty levels on the old 1-10 scale. The charts are made by MICHI, まっする, and RAG, respectively. It is the first ever jubeat song rated Level 10.0 or higher on BASIC, and was one of only two jubeat Qubell songs rated Level 10 on ADVANCED, the other being Sky High.
It is also the first jubeat song whose BASIC chart has more notes than the ADVANCED and EXTREME notecounts.

With 932 notes, Megalara Garuda's BASIC chart has the most notes of any jubeat BASIC chart, beating out previous record holder Elemental Creation -GITADO ROCK ver.-'s 586. With 912 notes, Megalara Garuda's ADVANCED chart has the fifth most notes of any jubeat ADVANCED chart, after Thanatøs's 1049, Crackpot Evangelist's 1039, XENOViA's 923, and Confiserie's 919 notes.
According to SYUNN in jubeat Qubell's booklet comments, Megalara Garuda's title was chosen because he started composing music in the same year the wasp species was discovered.
Megalara Garuda also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of the Qubell pack 17.

Megalara Garuda is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) from February 9th, 2022 by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS jubeat Selection Music Pack vol.1 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS jubeat セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1).

Megalara Garuda is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from June 24th, 2022, by purchasing SPECIAL music pack feat.jubeat vol.1 (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.jubeat vol.1). Its CHALLENGE charts become available by purchasing both this and SPECIAL music pack feat.jubeat vol.2 (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.jubeat vol.2).

Megalara Garuda is the first song in DanceDanceRevolution to have its DIFFICULT charts be rated Level 16, the highest for that difficulty. This mimicks Megalara Garuda's jubeat charts being initially rated Level 10 on all difficulty levels on the old 1-10 scale.
Megalara Garuda is available in pop'n music Lively as part of jubeat Selection Music Pack vol.1 (ユビートセレクション 楽曲パック vol.1).
songs.songConnections:
A long version of Megalara Garuda, titled Megalara Garuda(Long Version), can be found on the jubeat Qubell ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK album.

The two BGMs for the 掘りすぎ dig RUSH FINAL STAGE 4, both made by Shunsuke Sato, are completely based on Megalara Garuda.

Megalara Garuda shares several soundbites with ANCHOR, from beatmania IIDX 25 CANNON BALLERS and 星屑の夜果て, from pop'n music peace.

Bleep Beep Bop is one of the PHASE 2 unlocks of pop'n music Sunny Park's Waiwai pop'n doubutsuen (わいわいポップン動物園) unlocking event. It could be unlocked from August 12th, 2013. In pop'n music ラピストリア, it could be unlocked via Story Mode from September 12th, 2014.
In pop'n music éclale, it could be purchased from the Star Factory shop for 60 lumina.
As of pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢, it is available by default.

According to the pop'n music Sunny Park data, Bleep Beep Bop's temporary genre was korskオリジナルハードコア ("kors k original hardcore").
Bleep Beep Bop is available in pop'n music Lively by purchasing pop'n music Lively Music Pack vol.14 (pop'n music Lively 楽曲パック vol.14).

Bleep Beep Bop shares the "freestyle like you just don't care!" vocal sample with Light Shine.

A sequel to Bleep Beep Bop, Welcome!!, appears in jubeat clan.

A self-remix of Bleep Beep Bop, titled Bleep Beep Bop 2023, appears in kors k's Candy Rave Land Vol.1 album, alongside an extended version of it.
A remix by Akira Complex and kiraku, titled Bleep Beep Bop (Akira Complex vs kiraku 'Sweet&Spicy' Remix), also appears in Candy Land Rave Vol.1.

それは花火のような恋's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
それは花火のような恋 was added to BeatStream on April 17th, 2015.
それは花火のような恋 is Toshiyuki Kakuta's first original composition in the BeatStream series. It is also the first BeatStream original song composed by a member of the core beatnation Records team.
It also marks Mayumi Morinaga's only original song in the BeatStream series.
それは花火のような恋's video references the video of †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†. In the video, それは花火のような恋's character Haruka does the same "えいニャ!" pose as †渚の小悪魔ラヴリィ～レイディオ†'s character, Nagisa.
それは花火のような恋's title is translated on its jacket and video as "It is a love like fireworks".
それは花火のような恋 received a NIGHTMARE chart in BeatStream on April 23rd, 2015, unlockable via BEAST HACKER.

それは花火のような恋 is one of the unlocks of the Kaitou BisCo no yokokujou!! (怪盗BisCoの予告状!!) event. It could be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL from June 17th to December 21st, 2015, after the beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL Museum is completed. It is the only BeatStream song involved in the event that was only added to one other BEMANI series.
songs.songConnections: A sequel to それは花火のような恋, titled 抱きしめてモナムール, appears in beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage.

songs.title: CHERNOBOG
trivia: CHERNOBOG is automatically unlocked in jubeat Qubell from April 27th, 2017 by having unlocked it in BeatStream アニムトライヴ before February 13th, 2017, as part of Phase 10 of the BeatStream no ano kyokutachi ga jubeat demo asobechau! (BeatStreamのあの曲達がjubeatでも遊べちゃう！) event, being the final unlockable song of the event. In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
CHERNOBOG's NIGHTMARE jacket is used as the jubeat series' jacket.
CHERNOBOG also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of Qubell pack 18.

CHERNOBOG was unveiled in the final round of the BeatStream アニムトライヴ section of The 5th KONAMI Arcade Championship event. During its unveiling at The 5th KONAMI Arcade Championship, it was first shown as a joke song named タカハシサンのえかきうた, credited to はなうたBisCo and its BPM was shown as 573.
It was later available as the only unlockable song of Episode 1 of the BEAST CRISIS unlocking system of BeatStream アニムトライヴ. It can be unlocked from March 10th, 2016.

CHERNOBOG is the only song in a final release of the BeatStream series to have a chart rated Level Kami (神). In the BeatStream2 location tests, 恋する☆宇宙戦争っ!! had a NIGHTMARE chart rated Level 神 as well, but this chart never appeared on the final release of the game.
CHERNOBOG's NIGHTMARE chart has the most notes of any BeatStream chart, with 1132 notes.
Chernobog is a Slavic deity, whose name means black god.
CHERNOBOG marks Tatsuya Iyama's first use of his 漆黒のEBONY alias.

CHERNOBOG was added to pop'n music éclale on July 21st, 2016 as part of the BeaSt pop'n tanabata matsuri (ビースト ポップン 七夕まつり) event. It can be unlocked via Star Factory. To purchase it, you have to play アキネイション. In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, CHERNOBOG displays its BeatStream NIGHTMARE jacket on the song selection screen.
songs.songConnections: CHERNOBOG is related to BELOBOG, from SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN.

songs.title: Valanga
trivia: Valanga can be unlocked in jubeat Qubell as the Valanga～伝説の山～ STAGE 3 unlock of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system. For more information on the dates it can be unlocked, please see this page. In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
Valanga also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of the Qubell pack 17.

Valanga marks Yoshihiro Tagawa's debut in BEMANI. Valanga is also one of the few times when a BEMANI artist composes a boss song on their debut game as a composer, much like Hirofumi Sasaki's The Least 100sec, 96's 一網打尽, and PRASTIK DANCEFLOOR's second song Session 1 -Genesis-.

Valanga is the only unlockable song of the Pastel Adventure Legendary Mountain (伝説の山, densetsu no yama) event of REFLEC BEAT colette -Winter-, and is the final Mountain unlock for colette -Winter-. From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, Valanga was playable by default.
"Valanga" is Italian for "avalanche".

Valanga appears in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro and pop'n music Sunny Park as part of the Q-pro, Mimi, Nyami & Pastel-kun no minna de uchuu sensou!! (クプロ・ミミニャミ・パステルくんのみんなで宇宙戦争!!) unlock event, which started on July 29th, 2013. In beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA, beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL, and pop'n music ラピストリア, Valanga could be unlocked through the Hakken! Yomigaetta BEMANI iseki (発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡) event. From beatmania IIDX 23 copula onwards, Valanga is playable by default.
From July 23rd, 2015, it could be unlocked in pop'n music ラピストリア via Story Mode. In pop'n music éclale, it could be purchased from the Star Factory shop for 60 lumina.
As of pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢, it is available by default.
Despite being DJ TOTTO's first song that appeared in a BEMANI game, Valanga is not the first BEMANI song DJ TOTTO was involved in to be released in an original soundtrack.
Valanga is one of the songs featured on the BEMANI SONGS ～Best of REFLEC BEAT～ video.
songs.songConnections:
Valanga is the first song in DJ TOTTO's Legendary Mountain song series.

Valanga is sampled in KHAMEN BREAK -SDVX Infinity MashUp-, from SOUND VOLTEX II -infinite infection-, and in X-DEN, from beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage.

An updated version of Valanga, titled Valanga 2017, was played at the EDP×beatnation summit 2017 event. This version is used for Valanga's WHITE HARD chart.

A remix of Valanga by polysha, titled Valanga(polysha Remix), is playable in SOUND VOLTEX VIVID WAVE.

A chiptune arrangement of Valanga by かめりあ, titled Valanga -かめりあ's "RBc-GB" Arrangement-, appears in the beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE exclusive album BEMANI 8bit collection.

A vocal remix of Valanga by かめりあ feat. ななひら, titled ばらんが!!!!, appears in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR.

A remixed mashup of Valanga and 海神, titled VOLAQUAS, can be found in various BEMANI games as part of the いちかのごちゃまぜMix UP！ event.

ヤマトなでなで♡かぐや姫's generic movie was changed in BeatStream アニムトライヴ.

In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
In jubeat Qubell, it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the dig dig Qubell unlocking system.
In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.

HEAVENLY MOON's jubeat charts were created by まっする.

songs.title: Scars of FAUNA[2]
trivia: Scars of FAUNA is one of the songs for the Block Tournament section of the Tenkaichi otogesai Zenkoku issei nintei taikai (天下一音ゲ祭 全国一斉認定大会) event, representing the Earth element. It was added to GROOVE COASTER EX, jubeat saucer fulfill, maimai ORANGE, and 太鼓の達人 キミドリVer. on November 26th, 2014. In the GROOVE COASTER, maimai, and 太鼓の達人 series, Scars of FAUNA uses a slightly modified version of its jacket, by adding the jubeat saucer fulfill logo to it. Also, the artist is slightly changed to 猫叉Master「jubeat」より.

Ironically, while Scars of FAUNA was the only KONAMI original song added to jubeat in the 天下一音ゲ祭 event, it is also the only song from the event whose EXTREME chart was re-rated to Level 9 in jubeat clan.

Despite being a jubeat saucer fulfill original song, Scars of FAUNA does not appear on the jubeat saucer ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK -7 Bros.- album. Instead, it appears on the beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK VOL.2 album.
Scars of FAUNA's jubeat charts were created by RAG [1].
Scars of FAUNA [ 2 ] can be unlocked in jubeat clan from November 28th, 2017, as part of the NOBOLOT unlocking system. It can be purchased from the TORIDORI by clan RECORDS SHOP from May 24th, 2018.

In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART (note that unlike other songs, it cannot be obtained through Music Conduction). It could also be unlocked in jubeat festo from November 17th to December 14th, 2021, from June 1st to 14th, 2022, and from July 20th to 25th, 2022 as the レジェンダリーオータムメドレー！ PHASE LINE 2 unlock of the Mission Travel unlocking system.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
Scars of FAUNA's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.

Scars of FAUNA could be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL and REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper from April 2nd to 15th, 2015 as part of the 猫叉＆TOTTOと行くGW弾丸ツアー event. In beatmania IIDX 23 copula, it could be purchased with PULACO tickets from February 3rd, 2016. As of beatmania IIDX 24 SINOBUZ, it is available by default.
In REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA, it could be purchased from the Garage. In REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, it was available by default.

Scars of FAUNA can be unlocked in pop'n music ラピストリア from July 29th, 2015 as part of the BEMANI SUMMER DIARY 2015 event. Instead of displaying its character's portrait, Scars of FAUNA displays its jacket (with the BEMANI SUMMER DIARY 2015 logo) when selected.
In pop'n music éclale, it could be purchased from the Star Factory shop for 300 lumina. As of pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢, it is available by default.

In DANCERUSH STARDOM, the DANCE GUIDE choreography for ミッドナイト☆WAR was created by Viola [1].
ミッドナイト☆WAR was added to beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE on November 11th, 2021. It can be purchased from the SHOP for 15 MM.
ミッドナイト☆WAR is available in コナステ GITADORA as part of Tokubetsu kikaku SELECTION PACK (特別企画セレクションパック).
ミッドナイト☆WAR is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.18 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.18).
ミッドナイト☆WAR is available in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR コナステ from May 2nd, 2022, by purchasing Konasute SOUND VOLTEX Music Pack vol.16 (コナステ版 SOUND VOLTEX 楽曲パック vol.16).
ミッドナイト☆WAR is available in pop'n music Lively by purchasing pop'n music Lively Selection Music Pack vol.2 (pop'n music Lively セレクション 楽曲パック vol.2).

ミッドナイト☆WAR is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from July 4th, 2024, by purchasing GRAND PRIX music pack vol.28 (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.28). It received brand-new CHALLENGE charts, which become available by purchasing both this and GRAND PRIX music pack vol.27 (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.27).
By purchasing both packs with an active subscription, ミッドナイト☆WAR's CHALLENGE charts can be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD.
From July 31st, 2025 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, these charts are available by default for all players.
songs.songConnections: A piano arrangement of ミッドナイト☆WAR, titled ミッドナイト☆WAR(NOSTALGIA Style), is used in the ノスタルジア series.

songs.title: Surf on the Light
trivia: Surf on the Light could be unlocked in jubeat festo from July 3rd to 26th, 2020, as part of the Otodoke! Torokko daisakusen 2 (お届け！トロッコ大作戦2) event. It could also be unlocked from January 5th to 25th, 2022 as part of the Stamp Challenge unlocking system, by obtaining 5 stamps.
From jubeat Ave. onwards, it is available by default with an e-amusement pass.
Surf on the Light was added to jubeat (2021)'s normal mode on November 24th, 2021.

Surf on the Light is the Chapter 13 unlock of ノスタルジア's WAY OF NOSTALGIA. It can be unlocked from April 4th, 2017. In ノスタルジア Op.2, it can be unlocked from December 25th, 2018 as part of the Kaidan (階段) unlocking system.
In ノスタルジア Op.3, it can be unlocked from July 9th, 2020 from the FORTE ストーリー section at the Episode selection screen.
Surf on the Light is Tomoyuki Uchida's first song in BEMANI credited to his real name.

Surf on the Light could be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 24 SINOBUZ on August 1st and 8th, 2017 as part of the Version up kinen gakkyoku koukan (バージョンアップ記念 楽曲交換) event, by having played both ノスタルジア FORTE and beatmania IIDX 24 SINOBUZ from July 24th to August 6th, 2017. From February 7th, 2019, it can be purchased in beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage via Tenshi no madousho (天使の魔導書).
As of beatmania IIDX 27 HEROIC VERSE, it is available by default.

Surf on the Light being crossed over to beatmania IIDX 24 SINOBUZ marks Tomoyuki Uchida's first appearance in the beatmania IIDX series in nearly a decade, since 叶うまでは back in beatmania IIDX 15 DJ TROOPERS.
Surf on the Light's Expert chart was re-rated on February 27th, 2019 in ノスタルジア Op.2.
As of April 27th, 2022, it can be purchased at the festo STORE.
Surf on the Light is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.13 (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.13).
songs.songConnections:

The piano piece at the end of Surf on the Light samples the ending part from airflow.

In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
Sparkle Smilin' was added to jubeat (2021)'s normal mode on October 7th, 2021.
From September 29th, 2021 in DANCERUSH STARDOM, it can be purchased with 80★. From April 17th, 2024, it is available by default.
From October 21st, 2021 in DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS, it could be unlocked through EXTRA SAVIOR PLUS. From DanceDanceRevolution A3 onwards, it is available by default.
As of December 16th, 2021 in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR, it can be purchased with PCB.
From February 14th, 2022, it could be purchased in beatmania IIDX 29 CastHour with Archive Links (アーカイブリンク). As of beatmania IIDX 30 RESIDENT, it is available by default.

In ノスタルジア Op.3, it can also be unlocked through the limited time episode Toki wo meguru ongaku-sai Vol.IV (時を巡る音楽祭 Vol.IV), initially available for unlock from July 14th to September 22nd, 2022. From pop'n music UniLab onwards, it is available by default.

In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは was added to jubeat (2021)'s normal mode on November 24th, 2021.
恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは was unveiled in the Women's Division final round of the pop'n music éclale section of The 5th KONAMI Arcade Championship event.

恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは was added to pop'n music éclale on February 1st, 2016 to all players who completed the pop'n fuyu no stamp rally (ポップン冬のスタンプラリー) event, which started on December 24th, 2015. From March 10th, 2016, it could be purchased in the Star Factory for 1000 lumina.
As of September 28th, 2017 in pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢, it is available by default.
Karuta (かるた) are Japanese playing cards originally introduced to Japan by the Portuguese traders during the mid-16th century. For more information, see this page.

Q-Mex is mentioned in the song comments for 恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは, due to 恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは having the "ii kanji ii kanji" (いい感じ いい感じ) line on its lyrics, and ナタラディーン's sample "shri kanci" often being misheard as "ii kanji ii kanji". This is also referenced in 恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは's BeatStream video, where いろは is seen dressed in NaN (character of ナタラディーン)'s outfit during the line.
恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは's main BPM, 168, is goroawase for "iroha". Furthermore, 120 might be a reference to the twelfth pop'n music main game, pop'n music 12 いろは.
恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは's EX chart has a Spicy Gauge.
恋歌疾風！かるたクイーンいろは's EASY chart was re-rated in pop'n music éclale on March 22nd, 2016. It was re-rated again in pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢 on March 29th, 2017.
MIYABI san and KERI・MARO make cameos in いろは's WIN and LOSE animations.

trivia: XENOViA can be unlocked in jubeat festo from February 17th, 2022, as part of the TUNE RUN unlocking system. From July 6th, 2022, it can be unlocked as the festo島ライブカメラ PHASE LINE 2 unlock of jubeat festo's Mission Travel unlocking system.

XENOViA is BlackY's first original song in the jubeat series.

With 923 notes, XENOViA's ADVANCED chart has the third highest number of notes of an ADVANCED chart in the jubeat series, behind Thanatøs's 1049 and Crackpot Evangelist's 1039 notes. Its EXTREME chart has the fourth highest number of notes of an EXTREME chart with 1149 notes, behind 灼熱Beach Side Bunny's 1606, Crackpot Evangelist's 1252, and Thanatøs's 1219 notes.

XENOViA could be played from April 13th to 26th, 2022 in jubeat (2021) as part of The app is also dyed in BlackY's colors!? (アプリもBlackY色に染まるーー!?) event. It could be found in the "limited time" (期間限定) album. Upon its revival on February 22nd, 2023, XENOViA can now be found in the jubeat festo album.
XENOViA is also the third song in the jubeat series to have an EXTREME chart rated Level 10.9, after 1116 and RAISE YOUR HEADS UP.
It can also be unlocked via the Music Conduction feature.

海神 is one of the unlockable songs of the final phase of REFLEC BEAT colette -Summer-'s Pastel Adventure colette Fishing unlocking system. From REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, 海神 was playable by default.
海神 marks the first time Yoshihiro Tagawa composes a BEMANI song without using his DJ TOTTO alias.

海神 is one of the unlockable crossover songs for beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA and pop'n music ラピストリア on the 発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡 event. From September 19th, 2015, it could be unlocked in pop'n music ラピストリア via Story Mode.
In pop'n music éclale, it could be purchased from the Star Factory shop for 250 lumina.
As of pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢, it is available by default.
In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, 海神 displays its jacket (with the 発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡 logo) when selected.

海神 could be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution (2014) from January 22nd, 2015 as part of the BOSS ON PARADE event. To access 海神, you had to play any song in DanceDanceRevolution (2014) that has a REFLEC BEAT chart rated Level 10+ (Level 11 or higher in REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA/VOLZZA 2). Songs that debuted in DanceDanceRevolution and REFLEC BEAT simultaneously don't count. For a complete list of supported songs, please see this page.
From December 24th, 2015 onwards, 海神 has been automatically unlocked for all players.

海神 is one of the unlocks of the Kaitou BisCo no yokokujou!! (怪盗BisCoの予告状!!) event. It could be unlocked in BeatStream from June 17th to December 21st, 2015, after the REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper Museum is completed. In BeatStream アニムトライヴ, it could be unlocked from April 7th, 2016 via the BEAST CRISIS 外伝 (gaiden) unlocking system.
海神's generic movie was changed in BeatStream アニムトライヴ.

A short version of 海神 (Piano Arr.), titled 海神 (BEMANI SYMPHONY Arr.), can be found in ノスタルジア Op.3.

A remixed mashup of 海神 and Valanga, titled VOLAQUAS, can be found in various BEMANI games as part of the いちかのごちゃまぜMix UP！ event.

songs.title: I'm so Happy[2]
trivia: I'm so Happy is unlockable in the Black shirt class in jubeat knit and its APPEND version. The song may be unlocked for 10 Wool. In jubeat copious and its APPEND version, it is one of the UFO unlocks of the copious travel unlocking system.
In jubeat saucer, it can be unlocked via the bistro saucer unlocking event.
In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default.
I'm so Happy is one of four new songs in jubeat knit rated Level 10 on EXTREME, and Ryu☆'s first song in the series rated Level 10 on EXTREME.

I'm so Happy is available in DanceDanceRevolution X2 as part of the APPEND FESTIVAL event from March 10th, 2011. Playing the song on DanceDanceRevolution X2 will unlock Theory of Eternity for play in jubeat knit APPEND. I'm so Happy was not playable in the North American/European arcade release of DanceDanceRevolution X2 due to the lack of e-AMUSEMENT in those regions.
I'm so Happy was the final pre-jubeat copious KONAMI original to appear in jubeat plus, not appearing until music pack 25.
I'm so Happy is unlocked in REFLEC BEAT limelight by reaching the second part of jubeat Glass Stage 1. From REFLEC BEAT colette to REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, it is available by default.

I'm so Happy was added to pop'n music Sunny Park on December 5th, 2012, as part of the Sunny Park kaien kinen! pop'n music Sunny Park × jubeat saucer (サニーパーク開園記念！pop'n music Sunny Park × jubeat saucer) event.
I'm so Happy is one of the songs featured on the BEMANI SONGS ～Best of jubeat～ video.
When all of I'm so Happy's jubeat charts are cleared with a FULL COMBO, the jubeat title part "We're so Happy" is obtained, which hinted at its sequel.
songs.songConnections:
A long version of I'm so Happy appears on the jubeat knit APPEND SOUNDTRACK album.
Another long version of I'm so Happy, titled I'm so Happy (Extended RRver.), appears on Ryu☆'s third album, Rainbow☆Rainbow.

A different long version, featuring vocals by Lucky Vacuum, appears on the cyber beatnation 2 -Hi Speed conclusion- album.

A rock arrangement of I'm so Happy, titled I'm so Happy (Rockin' ver.), appears in GuitarFreaksXG3 & DrumManiaXG3.

A remix of I'm so Happy by kors k, titled I'm so Happy (kors k Remix), appears on the kors k vs. Ryu☆ CD The 4th EP.
A mashup of original version and kors k Remix, titled I'm so Happy (The 4th Mashup), can be found on The 4th's Force of The 4th album.

A sequel to I'm so Happy, titled We're so Happy, appears in jubeat saucer.

Another remix of I'm so Happy by polysha, titled I'm so happy(Happy Hoppin Remix), appears in SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS.

Another remix of I'm so Happy by P*Light can be found on Ryu☆'s third best of album, Ryu☆BEST -SUNLiGHT-.

I'm so Happy appears as part of POLICY BREAK Medley from SOUND VOLTEX×jubeat, which appears in SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN.

A piano arrangement of I'm so Happy by 事務員G can be found on the BEMANI PIANO COLLECTION ノスタルジア album.

An updated version of I'm so Happy, titled I'm so Happy (20th Anniv. Mix), appears in the cyber beatnation 4 -beatnation 20th anniversary- album.

In jubeat knit and its APPEND version, it is one of the Indigo Shirt unlocks.

ALL MY HEART -この恋に、わたしの全てを賭ける- was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see this page.

In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.
ALL MY HEART -この恋に、わたしの全てを賭ける-'s jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat clan ratings on March 7th, 2022.
ALL MY HEART -この恋に、わたしの全てを賭ける-'s subtitle means "In this love, I bet it all."
ALL MY HEART -この恋に、わたしの全てを賭ける-'s charts were created by いそにん.

songs.title: Chronos[2]
trivia: Chronos is one of the bistro saucer 5th Set unlocks of jubeat saucer. It could be unlocked from February 1st to 28th, 2013. In jubeat saucer fulfill, it can be unlocked as part of saucer macchiato's Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
In jubeat prop, it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
As of jubeat Qubell, it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass.

Chronos [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of jubeat festo's T-emo STORE. It could be purchased with 200 T-emo from August 5th to September 1st, 2019. It could be purchased again with 150 T-emo from February 3rd to March 2nd, 2020, and from August 3rd to September 7th, 2020.

Chronos's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022.
Chronos is GuitarFreaks V6 & DrumMania V6's ENCORE STAGE at Extra Level 6. At Extra Level 8, Chronos was moved down to EXTRA STAGE.
As of Extra Level 15, it is available by default after clearing the song on EXTRA STAGE.
Chronos is the god of time in pre-Socratic philosophy.
Chronos received new Drum and Bass charts, replacing the old ones, in GuitarFreaksXG3 & DrumManiaXG3. It also received brand new Drum, Guitar and Bass MASTER charts in GuitarFreaksXG3 & DrumManiaXG3.
Chronos can be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX by reaching ENJOY LEVEL 45. From DanceDanceRevolution (2013) onwards, Chronos is playable by default.
The DanceDanceRevolution series used the old GuitarFreaks & DrumMania jacket for Chronos. As of DanceDanceRevolution A, Chronos uses its current GuitarFreaks & DrumMania jacket.

songs.title: Conflict
trivia: In jubeat音乐魔方, conflict's artist is credited as siromaru&CRANKY.

conflict originates from THE BMS OF FIGHTERS 2011 -Intersection of conflict- Be-Music Source contest. It was the top rated song of the contest and is one of the most popular BMS songs. Its BMS genre is HARMONIC SCHRANZ.
It is the first BMS song to be licensed in a BEMANI game, instead of being a SOUND VOLTEX FLOOR submission.
conflict was added to SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS on December 24th, 2015.
conflict marks Cranky's first appearance in BEMANI. It is also Ryo Sakata's first song that is not a FLOOR contest one.
conflict is sung by Cranky's wife, pico.
conflict's lyrics are all made up of coined words.
conflict's jackets are designed by iimo, who made the video for the BMS version of the song.
conflict was added to SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ's INFINITE mode on June 1st, 2021.
conflict was added to ポラリスコード on April 18th, 2024.

conflict received an INFLUENCE chart as part of ポラリスコード's Hakkutsu! Caravan (発掘！キャラバン) event. It could be unlocked from December 11th, 2024 to March 27th, 2025 (originally until March 11th, 2025). Since August 7th, 2025, it can be unlocked through the Hakkutsu! Caravan universe (発掘！キャラバンユニバース) event.
conflict received an EXCEED chart in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR's ARENA STATION, available since May 15th, 2025. For more information on the dates it can be unlocked, please see the event page.
songs.songConnections:
The original, non-shortened BMS version of conflict with its official video was uploaded to YouTube.

The full version of conflict, titled conflict (Groundbreaking Edit), appears in the following albums: HEKATONCHEIR BEATS's compilation, Individual Shred-Core, the free release Groundbreaking -BOF2011 COMPILATION ALBUM-, and Cranky's solo album Rave-SLave 2017.

An updated long version of conflict, titled conflict (Rave Taisen 2016 ver.), appears in RAVETAISEN COMPILATION ALBUM 5th.

Various remixes of conflict have appeared on multiple different album releases:
conflict (lapix remix), appears in RAVETAISEN COMPILATION ALBUM 5th, as well as lapix's best of album, Flagship.

conflict (tpz Overheat Remix), appears in Rave-SLave 2017.

conflict (NAOKI coalesced Remix), appears in NAOKI's Dynamite Dynamite Rev. -NAOKI SPECIAL ALBUM- album.

conflict (VILA Remix), appears in Rayark's game Deemo, and later on Cranky's Rave-Slave 2019 album.

conflict (Roughsketch Remix), appears in CNCT Recordings' CONNECT ME!!! 2 album.

conflict (NOMA CONCEIVER REMIX), appears in NOMA's album Nominalism.

conflict (BlackY & Risa Yuzuki Remix), appears in their split album Idealize.

A chiptune arrangement of conflict, titled conflict(YM2151 edit), appears in Rayark's game Cytus.

A vocal cover of conflict by Nachi Tsukisuzu (CV: Ayaka Imamura), titled conflict(独唱), appears in SEGA's media mix project イロドリミドリ's album, GO! GO! チュウニズム♥【布】.

songs.title: Glitter Flatter Scatter
trivia: Glitter Flatter Scatter is the Emerald STAGE 13 unlock of jubeat Qubell's dig dig Qubell unlocking system. It can be unlocked from April 28th, 2016. In jubeat clan, it can be unlocked in the jubeat SHOP.
In jubeat festo, it can be purchased at the emo MART.
In jubeat Ave. and beyond the Ave., it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the LIGHT CHAT unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.

On April 13th, 2016, a link of a mysterious site titled G.F.S. appeared on the jubeat Qubell eAMUSEMENT site, with a date and a message posted on it every few days. On the April 27th, 2016 BEMANI Namahosou (kari) (BEMANI生放送(仮)) stream, the meaning of the G.F.S. site was revealed: Glitter Flatter Scatter's design page. The dates and messages posted on the site referred to previous Project B- songs' release dates and names.
On September 7th, 2017, a bug occurred in which playing jubeat clan did not fill the POLICY BREAK gauge, regardless of mode played. This was fixed later the same day.
Glitter Flatter Scatter also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of the Qubell pack 19.

Glitter Flatter Scatter is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from June 24th, 2022, by purchasing SPECIAL music pack feat.jubeat vol.2 (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.jubeat vol.2). By purchasing this pack with an active subscription, Glitter Flatter Scatter could be played in DanceDanceRevolution A3.
Glitter Flatter Scatter ranked #1 in the BEMANI Fan Site CHECK!SONGS Monthly Ranking list for May 2016.

Glitter Flatter Scatter is part of the POLICY BREAK event. For more information on the dates it could be unlocked in the SOUND VOLTEX series, please see the event page. From November 15th, 2018 in SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN, it can be purchased with BLOCKs instead.

Glitter Flatter Scatter was added to SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ's REGULAR course on August 1st, 2019. It is also available in GRAVITY WARS コナステ's INFINITE course and EXCEED GEAR コナステ from January 8th, 2020, by purchasing Konasute SOUND VOLTEX Music Pack vol.7 (コナステ版 SOUND VOLTEX 楽曲パック vol.7).
From June 30th, 2023 in DanceDanceRevolution A3, it is available by default for all players.
Glitter Flatter Scatter being crossed over to the DanceDanceRevolution series marks it as the first Akhuta song to appear in a BEMANI game since his departure from KONAMI.

songs.title: ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼"
songs.titleNorm: ピアノ独奏無言歌"灰燼"
trivia: ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" is the afterglow of Symphony PHASE LINE 1 unlock of jubeat festo's Mission Travel unlocking system. It can be unlocked from June 13th, 2022. In jubeat Ave., it could be unlocked in STAR RECORD from May 24th to June 13th, 2023, by lighting up 15 stars.
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" was added to jubeat (2021) on February 22nd, 2023.

ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" was first performed at the BEMANI SYMPHONY Concert 2022, held at LINE CUBE SHIBUYA on June 12th, 2022. At the concert, the song's title was also given in German: Lied ohne Worte "Asche-Traum", meaning "Song without Words "Dream of Ashes"". When ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" is played on beatmania IIDX, the arcade LED ticker displays the translated German title shown above.
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" was added to SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR on June 13th, 2022.
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼"'s SOUND VOLTEX charts have no knob paths, LONG BT or LONG FX notes, and thus do not have effector credits. It is the second song with this property, after ピアノ協奏曲第１番”蠍火”'s MAXIMUM chart.
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼"'s jacket is uncredited in the SOUND VOLTEX series.
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" is one of the MISSION BINGO unlocks of ノスタルジア Op.3. It can be unlocked from June 13th, 2022. It is the first song in the ノスタルジア series with a Normal chart rated Level 7.
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼"'s EXTREME chart has the fifth highest number of notes of an EXTREME chart with 1109 notes, behind 灼熱Beach Side Bunny's 1606, Crackpot Evangelist's 1252, XENOViA's 1149, and 1116's 1116.

ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" is one of the unlocks of pop'n music 解明リドルズ's Kaimei! MN tanteisha (解明！MN探偵社) unlocking system. It could be unlocked from June 16th, 2022 by solving NAKAJI's riddles. As of March 15th, 2023 in pop'n music UniLab, it is available by default.
In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" displays its jacket on the song selection screen.
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼"'s EX chart has a Spicy Gauge.

ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" is the BEMANI SYMPHONY TOURISM unlock of beatmania IIDX 29 CastHour's WORLD TOURISM event. It could be unlocked from June 23rd, 2022. From February 13th, 2023, it can be purchased in beatmania IIDX 30 RESIDENT with Hizou no record (秘蔵のレコード).
songs.songConnections:
ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" is likely a spiritual successor to ピアノ協奏曲第１番”蠍火”; pre-release promotional material for the BEMANI SYMPHONY Concert 2022 referred to it as the "new song from Virkato Wakhmaninov, composer of ピアノ協奏曲第１番”蠍火”".

A simplified version of ピアノ独奏無言歌 "灰燼" is used in the Normal and Hard difficulties in ノスタルジア, the EASY and NORMAL difficulties in pop'n music, as well as in the NORMAL difficulty in beatmania IIDX.

trivia: アガット [ 2 ] can be unlocked in jubeat clan from November 28th, 2017, as part of the NOBOLOT unlocking system.

アガット is the first song with Hold Markers that is not an alternate [ 2 ] chart for another song. Instead, its [ 2 ] charts do not have Hold Markers, being the first and only [ 2 ] charts to have this distinction.
Originally, アガット's artist was Jerico. This was changed to "Bazole" in an update for jubeat prop on March 4th, 2015.
